Bob was a big, tall man with a big, bushy mustache. All the other kids laughed at the way he organized his things. His friends tried to help him, but Bob was so harsh.

One day, Alice, a little girl, saw Bob organizing his things and said, "Let me help you, Bob!" Bob was so surprised and didn't know what to say.

Alice smiled and said, "I like your big mustache. Can I help you organize it better?"

Bob smiled and said, "Yes, I'd love your help."

So, with Alice's help, Bob organized all his things better. As they worked, Bob's friends watched and smiled.

When they were done, Bob thanked Alice and said, "You're a great helper. My mustache looks much better now!"

Alice giggled and said, "You're welcome, Bob. Your mustache is very cool!"

Bob smiled and said, "Thanks! Now, let's go have some fun."

Mia and her dad were walking down the street together, taking in all of the modern buildings. Overhead, the sun shone brightly in the sky.

Suddenly, Mia felt unsteady on her feet. She stumbled, almost falling down. Her dad quickly caught her, his strong arms steadying her. "Are you okay Mia?" he asked, with a smile on his face.

Mia nodded and the two of them continued walking. They stopped to look at a tall building, with a red roof and lots of windows. Mia's dad looked at the building and said, "Isn't this a modern building?"

Mia nodded again, and the two of them talked about all of the different things the building might have inside it. Then, Mia spotted a bird perched on top of the roof. She pointed to it and said, "Look Daddy, the bird is so happy at the top of that roof!"

Mia's dad laughed and they continued their walk, hand in hand.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat candy and play with her toys. One day, Lily's mom asked her to brush her teeth before going to bed. Lily didn't want to brush her teeth because the toothpaste tasted spoiled.

But then, Lily saw her favorite cartoon character surrender to the villain. She realized that surrendering wasn't always bad. So, she surrendered to her mom's request and brushed her teeth. It wasn't so bad after all.

After brushing her teeth, Lily went to bed feeling proud of herself. She knew that surrendering sometimes meant doing things that were good for her.

Once upon a time, there was a man who had a very special job. He was a repair man, and he liked to fix things that were broken! He was very good at his job, too.

One day, the man was fixing something special - a big copper pipe. It was going to take a lot of work to make it look nice and tidy again. He decided to use some tools to help him repair it.

First, he used a big hammer to straighten the pipe. He worked carefully and slowly, to make sure it was perfect again. He was so proud when he was finished!

Then, the man used a very special cleaner. It made the copper shiny and sparkly. With a few gentle wipes, he had it looking very tidy.

At the end of the day, the man was happy with his work. He had done a really good job. Thanks to him, the copper pipe was fixed and looked as good as new!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny. The bunny loved to run and play in the green grass. One day, the bunny saw a prune on the ground. It was a dark prune, almost black. The bunny picked it up and sniffed it. It smelled sweet!

The bunny decided to run with the prune in its mouth. It ran very fast, like a race car. It loved the feeling of speed. Suddenly, the bunny tripped on a rock and the prune flew out of its mouth. It was sad, but it learned to be more careful next time.

From that day on, the bunny always looked for dark prunes to play with. It loved the taste and the feeling of speed when it ran with them. The end.

Once there was a boy who was very jealous of his friends. He had seen them in a big raft out on the lake. He wanted to go in the raft with them but they wouldn't let him. He was feeling really bad and sad.

One day the boy found his own raft and decided he would take it out on the lake himself. He wished he could take it out with his friends, but he was sure they wouldn't let him. So he grabbed the raft and ran down to the docks.

When he got there, his friends were already there on their raft. He started to paddle out to them, when suddenly his paddle broke! The boy was so scared, he tried to get back to shore, but the wind was too strong.

He was stuck in the middle of the lake and started to cry. His friends had seen him and paddled closer to help him, but when he tried to make it to them, the wind would push him back.

Finally, his friends had to shut off their raft and turn back to get help. Unfortunately, by the time they got there the boy had been swept out to sea.

The moral of the story is that jealousy will lead you nowhere. The boy wanted to join his friends, but his own jealousy and pride drove him to take risks that could have been avoided. He should have been happy with what he had and not been jealous of his friends.

John and his mom were in an elevator going up to the top of a tall building. John was so excited he couldn't contain his excitement, so he started to laugh.

John's mom asked him why he was laughing and he said "I'm so happy to be going up in an elevator to the top of the building!".

His mom laughed and said, "That's a silly reason to be happy, John!".

John was a bit confused, but he kept laughing because he was so happy. Then, an ignorant man stepped into the elevator, he looked at John and his mom and said, "Why are you two laughing for no reason?".

John and his mom laughed even harder because of how ignorant the man was. The man said, "What's so funny?".

John's mom said, "We laughed because we were happy, not because we were being silly!"

John and his mom were laughing so much in the elevator that the man got out at the next stop and left them alone. John and his mom kept laughing, even after the man was gone. They were having too much fun to stop!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big nation with lots of trees and flowers. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. They were having fun on the swings and the slide.

Suddenly, Lily saw her friend Sarah crying. She asked her what was wrong. Sarah said that she had lost her toy. Lily wanted to help her, so she spread out her arms and started looking for the toy.

After a while, Lily found the toy and gave it back to Sarah. Sarah was very happy and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are so polite and kind!" Lily smiled and said, "I'm happy to help my friend." They continued playing and having fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a princess named Lily. She had a pretty dress that was pink and sparkly. One day, she met a prince named Jack. He had a big smile and a shiny sword.

"Hello, Lily," said Jack. "Will you marry me?"

Lily blushed and said, "Yes, I will marry you, Jack!"

But then, the king said, "Jack, you need a passport to marry my daughter. Go get one from the dark forest."

So, Jack went to the dark forest and found a passport. He brought it back to the king and he and Lily got married. They lived happily ever after.

Lila and Ben are twins. They like to draw with pastels. Pastels are soft and colorful. They make pretty pictures on paper.

One day, Lila and Ben find a big box of pastels in the closet. They are very happy. They take the box to the living room and open it. There are many pastels inside. Some are new and some are old. Some are long and some are short. Some are bright and some are dull.

Lila and Ben start to draw on the floor. Lila draws a flower. She uses red, yellow and green pastels. Ben draws a car. He uses blue, black and white pastels. They have fun and make a lot of noise.

Mom comes to the living room. She sees the pastels and the drawings on the floor. She is not happy. She has a serious face. She says to Lila and Ben: "What are you doing? You are making a mess. You cannot draw on the floor. You have to use paper. And you have to put the pastels back in the box when you are done. Do you understand?"

Lila and Ben feel sorry. They nod their heads. They say to Mom: "We are sorry, Mom. We like to draw with pastels. They are pretty. But we will not draw on the floor again. We will use paper. And we will put the pastels back in the box. We promise."

Mom smiles. She says to Lila and Ben: "That's good. I'm glad you like to draw with pastels. They are pretty. But you have to be careful and tidy. Now, help me clean up the floor. And then you can draw some more on paper. OK?"

Lila and Ben smile. They say to Mom: "OK, Mom. Thank you, Mom. We love you, Mom." They hug Mom. They help her clean up the floor. And then they draw some more on paper. They are happy.

Once upon a time there was a pretty house. Inside, a man and his family lived happily. One day, the family heard a noise outside. It was a thief! The thief was trying to break in and steal the man's precious things.

The family was scared, but they knew what they had to do. They quickly ran to the back door and opened it wide. Then, the man called out to the thief. He said, "You must leave now, or we will call the police!"

The thief was very scared and ran away. The family was relieved and thanked their lucky stars.

The next day, the man decided to set up a special lock on his door. This way, no thief could ever enter his house again. He put a big round button on the wall outside. Whenever someone wanted to come in, they had to press the button to release the lock on the door.

From then on, the family was safe and happy in their pretty house.

One day, a polite cat named Tom went for a walk. He saw a big chimney on a house. He thought it was fun to climb. So, Tom climbed the chimney. When he got to the top, he looked down and saw his friend, a dog named Max.

"Hi Max!" said Tom. "Look at me! I am on the chimney!"

Max looked up and saw Tom. "Oh no, Tom!" said Max. "You are too high! You might fall! Please come down!"

Tom wanted to come down, but he was scared. He tried to move, but he missed a step and slipped. Max saw Tom slip and ran to help him.

Max got a big, soft pillow from the house. He put it under the chimney. Tom fell on the pillow and did not get hurt. Tom was happy that Max helped him. They both learned to be careful when climbing high places.

Once upon a time there was a black cat. The cat was very lovely. She lived under a big tree near a little house. Every day, the cat would go to the house to find her dinner.

One day, the cat found a bowl of milk and some dry food. She was so happy! She ate every bit. After dinner, she went for a walk around the garden.

In the garden, she saw a beautiful flower. It was so lovely! She was very happy and started to purr.

Suddenly, she heard a voice. It was the little girl who lived in the house. She was calling out for her cat. The Cat and the little girl were very happy to see each other. They hugged and the little girl told the Cat how much she loved her. The Cat purred and enjoyed the love and cuddles.

And that is how the lovely black cat found a home and became very happy.

Tom and Lily were playing in the garden. They liked to dig in the dirt and look for bugs. They found a big mushroom that was brown and white. It looked yummy.

"Can we eat it?" Lily asked.

Tom shook his head. "No, no, no. Mommy said some mushrooms are bad. They can make you sick."

Lily pouted. "But it looks so good. I want to try it."

She reached for the mushroom, but Tom grabbed her hand. "No, Lily, don't!"

Suddenly, they heard a loud roar. They turned around and saw a big, ugly dog. It had sharp teeth and angry eyes. It was running towards them.

"Help!" Tom and Lily screamed. They dropped the mushroom and ran to the house. They were very scared.

The dog chased them, barking and growling. It wanted the mushroom. It thought it was a toy.

Tom and Lily reached the door and banged on it. "Mommy, mommy, open the door!"

Mommy heard them and opened the door. She saw the dog and panicked. She grabbed Tom and Lily and pulled them inside. She slammed the door and locked it.

"Are you okay, my babies?" Mommy asked, hugging them.

"Yes, mommy, we're okay," Tom and Lily said, sobbing.

"What happened? Why was that dog after you?" Mommy asked.

Tom and Lily told her about the mushroom. They said they were sorry for trying to eat it.

Mommy sighed. "It's okay, my babies. I'm glad you're safe. But you have to listen to me. Some mushrooms are bad. And some dogs are mean. You have to be careful in the garden."

Tom and Lily nodded. They learned their lesson. They hugged Mommy and said they loved her.

Mommy smiled. She loved them too. She gave them some cookies and milk. They forgot about the mushroom and the dog. They were happy.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a clean knob in his yard. He liked the clean knob and wanted to keep it. So, he decided to bury it in the ground to hide it from his friends.

Tim dug a small hole and put the clean knob inside. Then, he covered it up with dirt. He was very happy with his secret. Later, his friend Sally came over to play. They played with toys and had fun.

Tim wanted to show Sally the clean knob, but he was scared she would take it. So, he said, "Sally, I have a secret. I buried a clean knob in the yard, but you can't take it, okay?" Sally agreed and they went to the spot where Tim buried the knob. They dug and dug, but they could not find the clean knob.

Tim was sad and said, "I can't find my clean knob. I lost it." Sally felt bad for Tim, but she didn't know how to help. They looked for the knob all day, but they never found it. Tim was very sad and cried because he lost his clean knob. The day ended with Tim feeling upset and without his clean knob.

Lily liked to play with her purple ball. She would throw it, catch it, and roll it on the grass. One day, she saw a boy with a red ball in the park. He was playing by himself, too.

"Hi, I am Lily. Do you want to play with me?" she asked the boy.

"Hi, I am Sam. Sure, I like to play," he said.

They took turns throwing and catching their balls. They had fun and laughed a lot. They became friends.

"Can I see your ball?" Lily asked Sam.

"OK, here you go. Can I see yours?" Sam asked Lily.

They looked at each other's balls. They were different colors, but they were both round and bouncy.

"Your ball is nice. I like red," Lily said.

"Your ball is nice, too. I like purple," Sam said.

They smiled and hugged. They decided to play together every day.

Lily's mom came to pick her up. She saw Lily and Sam playing happily.

"Who is your new friend, Lily?" she asked.

"This is Sam. He has a red ball. We like to play," Lily said.

"That's wonderful, Lily. I am glad you met Sam. Can I take a photo of you two?" she asked.

"OK, mom. Say cheese, Sam!" Lily said.

They posed for the photo. They looked at the photo and saw their happy faces and their colorful balls.

"Look, mom. We are different, but we are the same. We both like to play and have fun," Lily said.

"Yes, Lily. You are right. You are different, but you are the same. You are both kind and friendly. That's what matters most," mom said.

Lily and Sam learned a lesson. They learned that they can be friends with anyone, no matter what they look like or what they have. They learned to respect and appreciate each other's differences. They learned to share and care. They learned to be happy.

Once there was a little boy named Tommy. Tommy loved to collect things. His favorite thing to collect were shiny rocks.

One day Tommy went to school. He entered his classroom and he was very excited. He saw that his teacher was very patient and he smiled at her.

Tommy's teacher told him she was going outside to collect leaves. Tommy was so excited! He went outside with the rest of the class and they collected leaves. They collected them in a special bucket.

Tommy was so proud of all the leaves he collected. His teacher praised him for being so patient while they collected the leaves. Tommy was so happy he ran back inside and showed the leaves to the other kids in his class.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was an intelligent kangaroo. His name was Sam. He was very friendly and he liked to jump around in the bush. One day, he went out to look for food. Suddenly, a big very mean animal appeared. It was a lion.

The lion wanted to spoil Sam. He wanted to eat him! Sam was scared, but he thought of a clever plan. He ran away as fast as he could and he was too quick for the lion.

The lion got very angry. He couldn't believe how intelligent the kangaroo was. He then decided to spoil other kangaroos in the bush. He ran around and scared them all.

Sam was sad. He saw the lion scaring the other kangaroos and he knew he couldn't do anything about it. He wished he had more power but he was just a kangaroo. So, Sam watched as the lion spoiled the other kangaroos. In the end he had to accept that the lion had the power and there was nothing he could do.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and chase butterflies. One day, she saw a puppy in the park. The puppy looked sad and lonely. Lily wanted to make the puppy happy, so she went over to him and gave him a big hug. The puppy felt better and started to wag his tail.

Lily wanted to take the puppy home, but she knew it wasn't her puppy to take. She asked the puppy where his owner was, but he didn't answer. Lily looked around and saw a distant figure walking towards them. It was the puppy's owner! The owner was happy to see the puppy and thanked Lily for giving him a hug. Lily felt happy knowing she helped the puppy feel better.

On a bright, sunny day, there was a chubby little goose who wanted to go on an adventure. She snapped her wings and off she flew! She flew over rivers, hills and trees, and had a wonderful time exploring the world.

Pretty soon, the little goose was getting tired. She snapped her wings and started flying back to her home. But when she got there, she was surprised to find a chubby little fox waiting for her. The fox sat still and smiled at her, and she was too tired to fly away.

The fox asked if the goose wanted to be his friend. The goose nodded and the fox motioned for her to follow. He led her to the edge of a forest, and with a snap of his tail he opened a secret door that led under the ground.

The little goose was amazed and curious. She stepped inside and what she saw made her heart smile. Everywhere she looked it was filled with chubby little animals who welcomed her with open wings. They showed her around and told her stories, and before she knew it, the sun was setting and it was time to go home.

The little goose said goodbye to all her new animal friends, and with a snap of her wings she flew back home. Every day after that she would come back and visit her animal friends, and they would always have wonderful adventures together.

Santa and his elves were very jolly. They made toys each day and had lots of fun.

One day, Santa noticed that it was taking a long time to make the toys. He knew he needed to hurry because Christmas was almost here.

The elves were not happy. They wanted to have time to play, but there was no time. This made them very upset.

Santa had an idea. He called out loudly and shook his snowflake-covered cane. All the elves stopped and looked at him.

Santa had a plan to make the most toys in the least amount of time. He asked the elves to work together and clap and sing as they made the toys.

The elves were excited. They worked faster than ever and the toys were finished in no time! Even though the elves were tired, they were still jolly. Santa was proud and thanked them for a job well done. Everyone had a good time and no one was disturbed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She wanted to go to the circus, but she didn't have a ticket. She asked her mommy if they could go, but her mommy said they needed a ticket first.

Lily was sad because she didn't know how to get a ticket. She asked her mommy if she knew how to get one. Her mommy said they could buy one at the circus, but they needed to go early.

The next day, Lily and her mommy went to the circus. They bought a ticket and went inside. At first, Lily was frightened by the loud noises and bright lights, but soon she was having fun watching the clowns and acrobats.

As they left the circus, Lily said to her mommy, "I know I want to go to the circus again!" Her mommy smiled and said they could come back next year.

Once upon a time, there was a big orange lion. He lived in a jungle with many trees and plants. One day, the lion saw a tiny ant walking on the ground. The ant was carrying a big piece of food.

The lion wanted to eat the food, but the ant said, "No, it's mine!" The lion roared loudly, but the ant didn't get scared. Instead, the ant said, "I am small, but I am strong."

The lion realized that the ant was right. He apologized and walked away. From that day on, the lion and the ant became friends and shared their food with each other.

Ben and Lily were twins who lived in a big house with their wealthy parents. They had many toys and books and clothes, but they were not happy. They wanted to go outside and play with other children, but their parents said no. They said the air outside was bad and they needed to stay inside and breathe oxygen from a machine.

One day, Ben and Lily saw a bird flying by their window. It was blue and yellow and sang a pretty song. They wondered how the bird could fly in the bad air and why it did not need a machine. They decided to ask their parents.

"Mom, Dad, can we talk to you?" they said.

"What is it, my darlings?" their mom said.

"We saw a bird outside. It was flying and singing. How can it do that?" they asked.

Their dad sighed and said, "The bird is different from us. It has a special body that can filter the bad air and make its own oxygen. We are not so lucky. We need the machine to help us breathe."

"But why is the air bad, Dad?" they asked.

Their mom looked sad and said, "The air is bad because of the people who do not care about the planet. They make too much smoke and trash and noise. They use up all the good things and leave nothing for others. That is why we are wealthy, because we have the good things and they do not."

Ben and Lily did not understand. They did not think the good things made them happy. They thought the bird was happier than them. They wished they could fly and sing and breathe like the bird. They wished they could meet other children who did not need machines. They wished they could see the planet and care about it. They wished they could be different.

One day, a weak bird named Tim wanted to deliver music to his friends. He lived in a big tree with many other birds. Tim loved to sing and make music, but he was not as strong as the other birds.

One morning, Tim met a big bird named Sam. Tim said, "Sam, I want to deliver music to our friends, but I am weak. Can you help me?" Sam smiled and said, "Yes, Tim! I can help you. We can make music together and share it with everyone."

Tim and Sam worked together to create beautiful music. Tim sang with his weak but sweet voice, and Sam played his strong wings like drums. The other birds heard the music and came to listen. They all loved the music and danced together.

In the end, Tim was happy because he could deliver music to his friends even though he was weak. And Sam was happy too, because he made a new friend in Tim. They all played and sang together, making the forest a happy place for everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hide-and-seek with her friends. One day, she found a crystal in the garden. She thought it was pretty and wanted to keep it. So, she hid it in her pocket and went back to play with her friends.

After a while, Lily's mom called her for lunch. She went back home and forgot about the crystal in her pocket. Later that day, Lily realized that the crystal was missing. She searched everywhere but couldn't find it. She was sad and wanted her crystal back.

The next day, Lily's mom found the crystal while doing laundry. She returned it to Lily and she was very happy. She decided to keep the crystal in a special place where it wouldn't get hidden again.

Once there was a little girl named Mandy. Mandy loved to spin around in circles. She would spin outside in the grass, in the living room, and even in her bedroom! One day, Mandy spun so much that she felt very dizzy. She decided to stop spinning and see if drinking some tea would make her feel better.

Mandy asked her mom for a cup of tea. Her mom made her a cup of hot tea with honey, so it was yummy. Mandy took a few sips of the warm tea but it still wasn't enough. Suddenly, an idea came to her. She asked her mom for a cold cup of tea.

Mandy's mom smiled and made her a cold cup of iced tea. Mandy took a big sip and it was just the refreshment she needed after all her spinning. She drank her iced tea and then went out to play in the sweet summer sun.

Once upon a time there was a small beetle who lived in a cozy home. He was very comfortable. Every day the beetle would leave his house to explore the world outside.

One day while he was exploring, a big storm started. The beetle was scared because he didn't know how to get home. Just then, he spotted a friendly caterpillar. The caterpillar saw the beetle was scared and quickly offered to protect him and take him home.

The caterpillar carefully guided the beetle back to his cozy home and kept it safe from the storm. The beetle was very grateful to the caterpillar for protecting him and offering him a place to be comfortable.

The caterpillar smiled and said, "You're welcome, little beetle. Friends protect each other!"

Once upon a time there were three best friends - Amy, Clare and Jake. They always liked to play together and go for treats.

One day Amy said to Clare and Jake, "Let's get a treat. I have some money I can use."

Clare and Jake both said, "Yes, let's go get a treat!"

The three of them went to the store and found the biggest treat in the shop. Amy said, "This one looks so yummy! I have to buy it."

Clare and Jake said, "No, you should save your money. We can share something else."
But Amy said she loved the treat too much and she bought it.

When they got home, Clare and Jake asked her to share the treat but Amy said, "No, this is mine. I paid for it."

Clare and Jake were sad and felt guilty. They loved Amy but they were mad at her too.

They never played together again and Amy was always alone with her treat.

Once upon a time there was a playful kitty. Her name was Tina and she loved to dream. Every day, Tina dreamed up the most amazing places.

One day, as she was dreaming, Tina spotted a long, dark tunnel. It was so magical and fun! She wanted to explore, so she went inside. As she walked through the tunnel, it changed colors and shapes. Suddenly, a soft light filled the tunnel and music started playing. Tina was so excited and playful.

Tina looked around and spotted a bunch of her friends. They were all playing together and having the best time. Together they danced, sang and laughed.

The tunnel was the most perfect place. Every day, Tina loved to return and dream her magical dreams.

Once there was a little girl called Millie who wanted to see a pink goal. She asked her dad to take her out but he said, "No, Millie, the park is closed."

Millie was so disappointed. She looked so sad and said, "But, Daddy, why can't I see the pink goal?"

Her Dad looked around and smiled. He then said kindly and quietly, "Don't worry, Millie. I have a special surprise for you. Let's go home."

So Millie and Dad went home and when they arrived, Millie gasped. There in her living room was a big pink goal! She ran to it and hugged it.

"I wanted to see a pink goal and now I can," she said with a big, happy grin. Dad smiled and said, "Yes, now you can. You can even close it if you want! So go ahead and close it."

Millie was so excited that she ran to the goal, closed it, and shouted, "I did it! I close the pink goal Daddy!" Dad laughed and said, "Yes, you did Millie. And now you can open it again, too!"

Millie opened the goal and was so happy she twirled around and around. She said, "Thank you Daddy for my special surprise!" Dad said, "You're welcome, Millie. I

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went on a walk with her mom. They saw a river with water that flowed fast. Lily wanted to touch the water, but her mom said no because it was dangerous.

Suddenly, they heard a voice from the bushes. It was a little boy who said he was lost and needed help. Lily's mom told her to stay put while she went to find the boy's parents.

But the boy lied. He was a bad person who wanted to hurt Lily. He came out of the bushes and pushed her into the water. Lily didn't know how to swim, and the water was too strong. She was taken away by the current and disappeared into the unknown.

Lily's mom came back and saw what happened. She cried and called for help, but it was too late. They never found Lily again. The boy was never caught, and he continued to lie and hurt others.

Once upon a time, there was a mom and her son. They went on a visit to a big store.
Mom said, "Let's trade our leftover candy for something more fun!"
The little boy was so excited. He said, "Yes please!"

They went inside the store and there were lots of different things available. There were games, toys, and treats. The little boy got very excited and started running around to look at them.

Mom asked, "What do you want?"
The little boy replied, "I want everything!"

Mom laughed and said, "Well, you can't have everything. But pick something you really like and we will do the trade."

The little boy thought carefully and finally chose a bright green toy rocket. He said, "I really like this one. Can we trade for it please?"

Mom said, "Sure! Let's do the trade."

The little boy was so happy and held the toy tight. He said, "Thank you mom! I love this rocket!"

Mom hugged the little boy and said, "You're welcome. I'm happy you like it!"

They both left the store with huge smiles on their faces. The little boy was very excited to play with his new toy rocket.

The end.

Lily and Tom were very happy to go to the beach with their mom and dad. They wanted to play in the sand, swim in the water, and see the fish. They packed their toys, towels, and sunscreen in a big bag.

When they got to the beach, they saw a lot of trash on the sand. There were bottles, cans, wrappers, and plastic bags. Lily and Tom felt sad and angry. They asked their mom and dad, "Who made this mess? Why did they not clean it up?"

Mom and dad said, "Some people are not careful with their trash. They leave it on the beach and it hurts the animals and the plants. It is very bad for the beach and the water. We should always throw our trash in the bin or take it home with us. That will prevent more trash from coming to the beach."

Lily and Tom nodded. They decided to help the beach. They put on their gloves and picked up the trash. They put it in a big bag and took it to the bin. They also found some shells and stones that they liked. They put them in a small bag to keep.

After they cleaned the beach, they played in the sand, swam in the water, and saw the fish. They had a lot of fun and felt proud. They said to their mom and dad, "We love the beach. We want to keep it clean and beautiful. We do not want to see any more trash. It is terrible for the beach and the water."

Mom and dad smiled and hugged them. They said, "We are very proud of you, Lily and Tom. You did a great job. You are very kind and responsible. You are good friends to the beach and the water. We love you very much."

Once there was a little girl who loved to play in the garden. One day she was watching the bees as they flew from one flower to the next. She wanted to be like them and fly too! The girl smiled and decided to try. She hugged her bear tight, then she spread her arms out wide. Suddenly a spray came from the sky and the girl laughed in delight.

The spray was a special spray that made her float up to the clouds. The clouds were fluffy and white and looked like cotton candy. The girl was so excited she wanted to stay floating among the clouds forever.

Meanwhile down on the ground, everyone was reading the news about a very patient girl who had sprouted wings and flew away in the sky. Everyone was fascinated by the story of the girl and wondered how she managed to float in the air.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to ride his bike. One day, Timmy was riding his bike down the street when he saw a cop car. The cop waved at Timmy and said, "Hey there, little guy! That's a perfect bike you have there." Timmy smiled and said, "Thank you, Mr. Cop!"

The cop asked Timmy where he was going, and Timmy said he was just riding around the neighborhood. The cop said, "Well, be careful and make sure you wear your helmet." Timmy nodded and rode off, feeling happy that the cop liked his bike.

As Timmy rode down the street, he saw his friend Billy playing in his yard. Billy said, "Hey Timmy, can I ride your bike?" Timmy said, "Sure, but be careful!" Billy hopped on the bike and rode around, feeling the wind in his hair. When he was done, he said, "Thanks Timmy, that was so much fun!" Timmy smiled and said, "I know, riding bikes is the best!"

Once upon a time, there was a kind man. He had an old, grey tie that he wore every day.

The man liked to record things. He recorded the birds singing, the rain falling, and the wind blowing. He was happy when he heard these sounds.

One day, the wind was so strong that it blew away his old tie. He looked everywhere, but he couldn't find it.

The man was sad, but then something wonderful happened. His kind neighbours came to help. They had found his old grey tie!

The man was so grateful and he thanked them. He recorded the moment so he would never forget it. He kept wearing his old grey tie after that, and he was very happy.

Tim and Mia are playing with blocks. They like to build towers and houses and cars. Tim has a big block that he wants to attach to his tower. He tries to put it on top, but it is too heavy and the tower falls down.

"Oops!" Tim says. "Sorry, Mia. Can you help me?"

Mia nods and picks up some blocks. She helps Tim to make a new tower. She puts a small block on top of the big block. Then she attaches another small block to the side of the big block. She makes a shoulder for the tower.

"Look, Tim!" Mia says. "Now your tower has a shoulder. It is very strong and tidy."

Tim smiles and hugs Mia. He likes his tower and his friend. He says, "Thank you, Mia. You are very smart and kind. Do you want to make a house next?"

Mia nods and claps her hands. She says, "Yes, Tim. Let's make a house. We can use the blocks to make walls and windows and a door. And we can use a blanket to make a roof. It will be fun!"

Tim and Mia start to make a house. They use the blocks and the blanket and their imagination. They have a lot of fun playing with blocks.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mommy in the kitchen. One day, her mommy asked her to get a bowl from the cabinet. Lily was very enthusiastic about helping and quickly found the bowl.

As they were making cookies, Lily's mommy asked her to pour the flour into the bowl. Lily was surprised when the flour made a big cloud and covered her face. She giggled and helped her mommy clean up the mess.

After they finished making the cookies, Lily's mommy gave her a big hug and said, "Thank you for being such a great helper, Lily!" Lily felt very proud and happy. She couldn't wait to surprise her daddy with the delicious cookies they made together.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny who was feeling very sad. He was so sad that he wanted to quit. He sat in his house feeling gloomy, until one day he had an idea.

He grabbed his ashtray and hopped outside. He searched until he found a dead tree. He put his ashtray right under the dead tree and he hopped and he hopped until he reached the top.

The bunny looked down and saw that the ashtray was still there. He felt so happy. He hopped back down and sat in the ashtray. He was so comfy that he decided not to quit anymore.

The bunny thanked the dead tree and waved goodbye as he hopped back home, feeling much better than before.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah who loved to explore outside. She was very brave and one day decided to go explore a creek.

Sarah came to a creek which was very filthy. The water was dark and had a bad smell. But Sarah was not scared. She loved to explore, so she stepped closer.
Suddenly, Sarah lost her balance and fell into the creek. She was very afraid and started to cry out for help.

A kind lady heard Sarah's cries for help and quickly came to the creek. Together she and Sarah pulled herself safely out of the creek.

The lady said to Sarah, "You were very brave to explore the creek, but it's too dangerous for a little girl like you. Next time make sure you stay away from this filthy creek!"

Sarah thanked the kind lady and promised never to fall into the creek again. She went away happily and never explored that filthy creek again.

Mum and Dad were in the kitchen together. Mum was cooking some food in a big pot, and there was a delicious smell coming from it. Dad was watching, and said she was doing a good job!

Then Dad put his hand in his pocket and brought out a red wallet. Out of the wallet, he took a few coins, and put them in the pot. Mum smiled and gave Dad a big kiss!

Next, Mum took the pot off the stove and poured the food into a bowl. The food looked so yummy and had some coins in it - like a special surprise. Dad and Mum shared the food, and it tasted even better than it smelled!

They were so happy they had cooked something delicious, and Dad said he loved Mum very much.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird who loved to sing. Everywhere the bird went, it sang a lovely song. All the other animals in the forest enjoyed the bird's song.

One day the bird was singing when it saw a flower. The bird stopped singing and looked at the flower. It was so pretty that the bird couldn't help but to sing a special song. It was a song of love and kindness, just for the flower.

The flower smiled and said, "Thank you for your lovely song!" The bird was so happy. It sang its song even louder, and all the other animals in the forest clapped and cheered.

From that day on, the bird would go to the flower every day to sing its song. The flower liked it so much that it even gave the bird a special present, a bright yellow ribbon. The bird flew away with the ribbon around its neck, singing its lovely song.

A boy was walking in the park and saw a high tree. He wanted to pick its fruits as they looked very juicy and sweet. He climbed the tree and tried to reach them, but he couldn't reach even the lowest one. He was sad and started to cry.

Suddenly, an old man appeared, who was wearing a beautiful bathrobe. He said, "Do not worry, my boy, I will help you reach those fruits." He stretched out his arms and pinched the biggest, juiciest one from the tree.

The boy was so happy for the old man's help and thanked him many times. Before leaving, the old man gave the boy the fruit and said, "Do not forget to eat your fruit after taking a bath!"

The boy took a bath and, wearing his bathrobe, he enjoyed the sweet fruit. Grateful for the old man's help, he thanked him in his thoughts.

Molly was feeling excited. She was jumping around and singing. Suddenly, she started to yawn. Her mom smiled and said, "Let's get some rest, honey." Molly nodded and they both went to her room.

Molly tucked herself in and yawned again. Her mom said, "Let's have an apple before bed." Molly grinned and jumped out of bed. She found an apple in the kitchen and bit into it. The apple was so delicious!

Molly was more excited than ever. She started running around, chomping on her apple. Her mom laughed and said, "Time for bed! What a enthusiastic girl you are." Molly yawned once more and put down the apple. She jumped into bed and quickly fell asleep.

One day, a modern mouse was scurrying around. She was very proud of her shiny fur and long whiskers. She wanted to find a new place to explore.

But, people walking nearby ignored her. They did not have time for a little mouse. Unlucky for her, they could not understand how excited she was about discovering the world.

The mouse decided to find a new place all on her own. She ran and ran and ran. Finally, she came across a tree with lots of holes. It was perfect! She knew she could explore lots of new places and the tree was perfect for hiding.

The mouse was so happy. She squeaked and squeaked. But, even though she was so excited, the people walking by still ignored her.

But that was OK, because the modern mouse was now the proud owner of her own tree! It was just perfect!

Sara likes cereal. She likes to eat it every morning. She likes to put milk and bananas on it. She likes to eat it with a spoon.

One day, Sara sees a new box of cereal. It is black. She does not like black. She thinks black is yucky. She does not want to eat it.

She says to her mom, "Mom, I do not want this cereal. It is black. I want my old cereal. It is yellow and brown. It is yummy."

Her mom says, "Sara, this is a special cereal. It is not yucky. It is crunchy and sweet. It has chocolate in it. Do you like chocolate?"

Sara likes chocolate. She likes to eat it sometimes. She thinks chocolate is yummy. She says, "Yes, I like chocolate. But I do not like black."

Her mom says, "Why don't you try it? Just one bite. Maybe you will like it. It is good for you. It has vitamins and minerals. Do you know what vitamins and minerals are?"

Sara does not know what vitamins and minerals are. She thinks they are hard words. She does not care about them. She cares about yummy and yucky. She says, "No, I do not know. I do not want to try it. I want my old cereal."

Her mom says, "Okay, Sara. I will not make you eat it. But I will eat it. It looks delicious. Can I have some milk and bananas, please?"

Sara says, "Okay, mom. You can have it. But I will not. I will have my old cereal. Here is some milk and bananas. Can I have some chocolate, please?"

Her mom says, "Yes, Sara. You can have some chocolate. But only a little bit. And only after you finish your cereal. Deal?"

Sara says, "Deal, mom. Thank you. I love you."

Her mom says, "I love you too, Sara. You are a good girl. Now let's eat our cereal. Bon appetit!"

Lily was eager to go to the party. She had a costume of a fairy. It had wings and a wand. She wanted to show her friends.

But her costume was dirty. She had played with it in the garden. There was mud and grass on it. She was sad.

"Mama, can you clean my costume?" she asked.

"Of course, my dear. But you have to help me. We have to hurry. The party is soon." Mama said.

Lily nodded. She helped Mama put the costume in the washing machine. She pushed the buttons. She watched the water spin. She waited.

The washing machine beeped. Mama took out the costume. It was clean and shiny. Lily smiled.

"Thank you, Mama. You are the best." she said.

"You are welcome, my sweet. Now, let's dry it and put it on. You will be the prettiest fairy at the party." Mama said.

Lily hugged Mama. She was happy. She put on her costume. She twirled and flew. She was ready to go.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to race his toy cars around the house. One day, he was racing his favorite car when he accidentally knocked over his mom's vase. His mom got very mad and told him to clean it up.

Timmy was sad and didn't know what to do. He decided to go outside and race his cars there instead. While he was racing, he saw a cop car drive by. The cop looked very tough and serious. Timmy asked the cop if he could race his toy cars too.

The cop smiled and said, "Sure, let's race!" They raced their cars down the street and had a lot of fun. Timmy forgot about breaking the vase and felt much better. He thanked the cop for racing with him and went back inside to clean up the mess. From then on, he made sure to be more careful when racing his cars inside the house.

One day, a small rabbit was racing through the forest. He was so fast! He was racing with a fan in his mouth.

The rabbit had a race with a little mouse. He was so excited! He wanted to win. He raced and raced, but the mouse was too fast. The rabbit was sad.

But then the wind blew, and the fan made the rabbit go faster. He raced so fast that the mouse couldn't keep up. The rabbit won the race! He was so happy.

The fan cheered for the little rabbit. Everyone was so proud of him. He was a small rabbit, but with the help of the fan, he was able to become the winner.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to visit her grandma. She walked through the forest and saw a big, brown horse. The horse looked friendly and Lily wanted to bring it to her grandma's house. She asked the horse to come with her and it followed her happily.

When they arrived at grandma's house, Lily was very hungry. Her grandma made some yummy cookies and gave one to Lily. Lily wanted to share the cookie with the horse, but it couldn't eat it because it was too big. So, Lily went outside to find some grass for the horse to eat.

But when she came back, the horse was gone! Lily searched everywhere but couldn't find it. She felt sad and cried. Her grandma comforted her and said that sometimes animals like to go back to their homes. Lily felt a little better but still missed the horse. She never saw it again. The end.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Ben. Ben loved to play in his backyard. He would play with his blocks and his toys.

One day, Ben decided to climb up on the shed in his backyard. He thought he would be safe up there, but he was wrong. The shed was too high for him and he started to fall. Luckily, just before hitting the ground, his dad caught him!

"Ben, you need to be careful!" his dad said to him. "Things aren't always as comfortable as they seem. You need to think carefully before you try something new like this. You could have been really hurt!"

Ben thought about what his dad said and the next time he went to play in the backyard he chose to stay on the ground. He learned it was better to be safe than to be comfortable.

Once upon a time, there lived two best friends: Sarah and Josh.

Every day they went to the beach and played together. As they ran and laughed, they stumbled upon a small tank full of yummy treats.

Josh said,"Let's shut the tank and save the treats for later!"

Sarah smiled and nodded. Quickly, they shut the tank tightly.

The day went quickly, and the sun began to set. As Sarah and Josh packed up to go home, Sarah said "What about the tank?"

Josh smiled, "Let's hurry back soon and open it up for a yummy treat."

The two friends ran home. When they returned the next day, they opened the tank and shared the yummy treats as they laughed and played in the sun.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Mary. Mary was always told she needed to behave, but sometimes she just wanted to be crazy.

One day, Mary was outside playing when she saw a storm coming. She heard the thunder and it sounded so loud, she got scared and started to cry.

Her mom came outside and told her to not be afraid. She said that thunder was just the sky talking and she showed Mary how to make thunder of her own and laugh with it.

Mary thought this was so cool! She laughed and made lots of thunder and acted crazy with it. Mary's mom was so proud of her for behaving. She even got a big hug from her mom for being so brave during the storm!

Once upon a time there was a brown junk. It had lots of pieces that wouldn't stay together. One day, a kid came by and saw the junk. She wanted to fix it up.

The kid grabbed some spray and started spraying the junk. The aerosol made the brown junk look shiny and new. Now it was easier to fit the pieces together.

The kid kept spraying until everything was attached. She looked at the junk with pride. Now it was nice and new! She was very happy and went off to play with her new toy.

The end.

Once upon a time, there were two brothers who were best friends. One day, they were very hungry. The first brother said, "Let's go eat some lunch."

The second brother thought for a minute and said, "I want steak. That's what I want."

The first brother was surprised. "Steak? That's a big, fat, grown-up food."

The second brother wouldn't change his mind. He insisted, "I want steak!"

So, the first brother said, "Ok, let's go get some steak."

The brothers went to the store and bought a big, fat steak. When they got home, the second brother cooked the steak and shared it with his brother. They both enjoyed the steak a lot and felt very happy and full.

Tom and Jen are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big red truck. It has a loud horn and a long hose. The truck is going to the west. Tom and Jen want to see what is happening.

They run after the truck. They see a lot of smoke and fire. A house is burning. The fire is very hot and scary. The truck stops near the house. The men in the truck wear yellow hats and coats. They use the hose to spray water on the fire. They try to make the fire go away.

Tom and Jen watch from far away. They see a fat cat on the roof of the house. The cat is scared. It meows and cries. The men see the cat. They use a ladder to climb up to the roof. They pick up the cat and bring it down. The cat is safe. The men give the cat to a lady. The lady is happy. She hugs the cat and thanks the men.

Tom and Jen clap their hands. They think the men are brave and kind. They think the cat is lucky and cute. They go back to the park. They play with their toys. They talk about the fire and the truck and the cat. They are glad that everyone is okay. They are good friends.

Once upon a time there was a beautiful elderly lady who was walking in the park. She saw a hive buzzing with bees in a tree and she knew she needed to be careful. She slowly moved closer and saw something small on the ground. After taking a closer look she noticed it was a tear. She smiled as she recognised it as a bee tear.

The elderly lady carefully picked up the bee tear and looked around for the bee that had dropped it. She saw a cute bee buzzing around and flew towards the hive.

The bee tear made the elderly woman feel kind and she decided to give the bee a hug. She stepped closer, carefully so as not to disturb the hive, and hugged the bee. The bee smiled and flew away happily.

The elderly lady smiled as the bee flew away, feeling like the hug had helped the bee in some way. She looked up at the hive, feeling happy that the bees were safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy who loved to lie in the sun. But, one day the puppy heard something dangerous. He heard a loud growl and started to tremble in fear. He wanted to run and hide, but he knew his place was outside in the sun.

Suddenly, the puppy heard a meow. He opened his eyes to find a friendly cat looking at him. "What's the matter?" asked the cat. "I heard something dangerous growling nearby," the puppy replied. "That was just a warning. Don't be afraid. Everything will be alright," said the cat.

The puppy thought about what the cat said and took a deep breath. He looked around and realized that the dangerous growl came from his own reflection in a nearby pond. He had been so scared by the sound that he almost ran away!

The moral of this story is that sometimes it's easy to get scared by something that isn't really there. Don't be so quick to lie and run away. Face what you're afraid of. It might not be as dangerous as you think!

Once upon a time, there was a mama cow who wanted to succeed. She had no idea where to start, so she tried to think of a creative way to make something delicious. Suddenly, she remembered her favorite food was beef!

Mama cow excitedly mooed, "That's it! I will make beef!"

Mama cow went out to find grass, water and sun to make her beef. After a while, she had enough. Now, it was time to make the beef.

Mama cow used all her creative ideas to put the beef together. She tried different flavors and spices until it was perfect.
Finally, mama cow looked at her beef and shouted, "I did it! I succeeded!"

Mama cow enjoyed her beef and was very proud of herself. With hard work and creativity, she had succeeded in making the most delicious beef ever!

The church was big and tall. It was made of wood and stone and it was very heavy. There were lots of people inside, all coming together and singing.

One of the people was a little girl called Emily. She was only three and she was feeling very scared and sad. She wanted to find a friendly face to make her feel better.

All of a sudden, Emily saw a man in the corner who was smiling at her. She ran to him and gave him a big hug. He was so kind and loving and he hugged Emily back.

The man told Emily that she should come to church every Sunday, and that he would take care of her. Emily smiled, feeling happy and safe knowing that she had someone to hug and love her.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play hockey with his friends. He would always run around with his stick and try to score a goal. One day, Timmy's friend Johnny came to play with him. Johnny was very impatient and always wanted to win.

Timmy and Johnny started playing hockey together. Johnny was very good at hockey and kept scoring all the goals. Timmy felt sad because he couldn't score any goals. But Timmy had a secret trick up his sleeve. He knew how to bow very low and sneak up on Johnny.

When the time was right, Timmy bowed low and snuck up on Johnny. He quickly took the puck and scored a goal! Johnny was surprised and happy for Timmy. From that day on, Timmy and Johnny played hockey together and had lots of fun.

Max was feeling very silly. He wanted to cover his package with something special. He wanted something that would cover it, keep it safe and make it look nice. So he went to his mom and asked her for help.

She thought that was a foolish idea, but she was willing to help. She took Max to the store, where he found some colorful paper, ribbons and stickers.

Max was so excited! He thought his package would look really nice with those special things. So he got to work covering his package. He stuck the stickers on and tied the ribbon around it. He gave his package a big grin when he was all finished.

His mom and dad were so proud of him. They said his package looked perfect! Max was very happy and felt proud of himself. He had covered his package just the way he wanted.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a piggy bank where she saved her money. One day, she went to the store with her mom and saw an incredible toy that she really wanted. She asked her mom if she could buy it, but her mom said she didn't have enough money.

On the way home, Lily started to feel very sleepy. She tried to stay awake, but she couldn't help but yawn. When they got home, Lily went straight to bed and fell asleep. The next day, she woke up and remembered the toy she wanted. She decided to save her money until she had enough to buy it.

Every day, Lily would put some of her money into her piggy bank. It took a long time, but eventually she had enough money to buy the incredible toy. She was so happy and couldn't wait to play with it. From that day on, Lily learned the importance of saving her money and how incredible it feels to finally buy something she really wanted.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play hide-and-seek with his friends. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a mask to wear. The mask was dark and covered Timmy's face.

Timmy put on the mask and ran outside to play with his friends. When it was his turn to hide, Timmy found a good spot behind a tree. But when he tried to come out, the mask got stuck on a branch.

Timmy tried to pull the mask off, but it wouldn't budge. He started to get scared because he couldn't see anything. Luckily, his friends heard him crying and came to help. Together, they pulled the mask off and Timmy was so happy to see again.

Once upon a time there was a navy. The navy was organized and ready for an adventure. The captain was so happy, he wanted a kiss from everybody in the navy. So, he went around and kissed the sailors one by one. They were so happy to get a kiss from the captain that even the littlest kids smiled.

The navy sailed to lots of places and saw plenty of sights. But no matter what kind of adventure the navy got into, the captain was always there to give kisses. They were especially special when the navy saw something exciting.

Eventually, the navy sailed back to their home port. As soon as they arrived, the captain gave each sailor one final kiss goodbye. That made everyone happy, even the littlest ones. They all knew that they had had a great adventure together and that the captain would always be with them in spirit.

Once upon a time there was a kind bear. He lived in a big forest. Every day, he would go around the forest asking questions. One day, he asked an old tree what the best surprise was. The tree thought for a moment and then said the perfect surprise was a friend.

The bear was happy. He wanted a friend too! He ran around the forest looking for one. He asked all his friends in the forest but none of them wanted to be his friend.

The bear was sad, but then he saw a small bunny. The bear asked the bunny if it wanted to be his friend. The bunny said yes!

The bear was so happy. He and the bunny hugged and played together every day. The bear finally had the perfect surprise - a very special friend.

There was once a clumsy girl named Sue. She had a nice vest that made her feel happy and special. Every day, Sue would put on her vest and show it to her friends.

One Saturday morning, Sue went to put on her vest. But, as she reached for it, Sue tripped and the vest flew into the air. She reached up to grab it, but it was too late. She watched as her vest flew away towards the sky.

Sue was very sad. She realized that she had been too clumsy and now her vest was gone. She said goodbye and waved at her vest as it got further and further away.

Sue never found her vest again. She realized that she had been too clumsy and lost something special.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a phone that she loved to play with. One day, while she was playing with her phone in the park, a boy came and took it from her. He stole her phone! Lily was very sad and cried a lot.

But Lily was a persistent girl. She didn't give up. She looked for the boy who stole her phone and found him. She asked him to give her phone back. The boy didn't want to at first, but Lily kept asking and asking. She was very persistent. Finally, the boy gave her phone back and apologized.

Lily was very happy to have her phone again. She learned that sometimes you have to be persistent to get what you want, but it's always better to ask nicely instead of stealing.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Jack and Sarah. One day, Sarah found an old glove and put it on. Jack didn't recognize what it was, so Sarah told him it was a glove. Jack asked Sarah why he couldn't see it, and Sarah said it was because it was soft and they had to look closely.

Jack still didn't recognize it and got a little upset. He wondered why Sarah was able to find the glove and not him. Sarah tried to explain that it was because the glove was soft and he would have to look more carefully, but he didn't understand.

Suddenly, Jack had a great idea. He handed Sarah his toy and asked her to hide it the same way she had hidden the glove. She did, and this time Jack was able to spot it right away. He knew it right away because it was soft and he had to look more carefully. Jack and Sarah were both very glad that Jack could recognize the soft glove and they both laughed.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a tall man. The tall man had a big dog. They were best friends. They liked to play together in the park.

One day, the tall man lost his red ball in the park. He was sad. He asked his big dog to find the red ball. The big dog nodded his head and went to look for the red ball. He ran and sniffed all around the park.

Finally, the big dog found the red ball near a tree. The tall man was very happy. He gave the big dog a reward for finding the red ball. The reward was a big bone. The big dog wagged his tail and ate the bone. They played with the red ball together and went back to their small house. They were happy.

Once upon a time, there was a funny owl named Hoot. Hoot loved to make his friends laugh by telling silly jokes. One day, Hoot's friends had an argument and they were not talking to each other anymore. Hoot felt sad and wanted to help his friends unite again.

He flew to each of his friends and said, "Let's be friends again. It's not fun when we're not together." His friends listened to Hoot and realized that their argument was not important. They hugged each other and said sorry.

Hoot felt happy that he could help his friends unite again. He learned that it's important to be a good friend and to help others. The moral of the story is that friendship is important and we should always try to make things right when we have an argument with our friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and collect rocks. One day, she found a big rock that made her very excited. She wanted to keep it forever and show it to all her friends.

But as time passed, Lily noticed that the rock started to shrink. It became smaller and smaller until it was just a tiny pebble. Lily was sad because she realized that everything in life eventually shrinks or goes away.

From that day on, Lily learned to appreciate the things she had while she had them. She knew that even though things may shrink or disappear, the memories and joy they brought would always stay with her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play outside in the grass. One day, she found a big hole in the ground. It was very deep and she had to be careful not to fall in.

Lily saw a sharp stick on the ground and she picked it up. She wanted to use it to see how deep the hole was. But her mommy said, "No, Lily, that stick is too sharp. You could hurt yourself. Let's find something else to use."

So, they found a long stick that was not sharp. Lily carefully put the stick down into the hole. It was very deep! She was happy she didn't fall in. From that day on, Lily was always careful when playing near holes and never picked up sharp sticks again.

Anna and Ben are playing in the sand. They have a big bucket and a small shovel. They want to make a sand castle.

"Look, Anna, I made a tower!" Ben says. He puts some sand in the bucket and turns it over. A sand tower comes out.

"Wow, Ben, that's a good tower!" Anna says. She makes another tower next to Ben's. They make four towers and a wall.

"Let's make a door for our castle," Ben says. He digs a hole in the wall with his shovel.

"OK, Ben, but be careful," Anna says. She helps him make the door.

They are happy with their sand castle. They sit inside and pretend to be a king and a queen.

"Who goes there?" Ben asks. He hears a voice outside the door.

"It's me, Mommy!" the voice says. "Can I come in?"

Anna and Ben look at each other and smile. They like Mommy.

"Yes, Mommy, you can come in!" they answer. They move aside and let Mommy in.

Mommy sees their sand castle and hugs them.

"What a beautiful castle you made!" Mommy says. "You are very clever and creative!"

"Thank you, Mommy!" Anna and Ben say. They are proud and happy.

They show Mommy their towers and their wall and their door. They invite Mommy to sit with them and play.

They have fun in the sand. They are a happy family.

Once upon a time there was a princess. She was so pretty and loved to dance. One day a terrible monster came into town. She was scared and didn't know what to do.

The princess decided to face the monster and show him her dancing. She twirled and spun on her toes and the monster couldn't help but start to dance too! He spun and twirled around and around with the princess.

The people of the town started to laugh and cheer. They were so happy that the princess had used her dancing to make the monster happy and go away. Everyone thanked the princess and said she was the bravest princess ever!

The princess smiled and said she was just happy to dance. From that day on, she always made sure to practice her dancing so she could keep the town safe.

Once there was a girl named Alice. She loved to sing. Every morning she would wake up singing. One day Alice wanted something sweet. So she went to the kitchen and found a big delicious pie. It was so yummy that she couldn't wait to sing her song.

Alice started singing and dancing around the kitchen. She was so happy that she spun around and around. But when she spun, her hands got wet and she dropped the pie. It fell right into a big puddle on the floor.

Alice was sad. She thought that she had ruined the lovely pie. But then something magical happened. Alice looked down and the pie had changed into a bunch of yummy little pies! She was so excited that she started singing again.

Alice was so happy that she invited all her friends over to share the delicious pies. They all sang together and it was so much fun. The pies made everyone happy, even when it was wet outside. What a fun day it was!

Ben and Lily were playing with blocks in the living room. They liked to build towers and houses and bridges with the blocks. But they did not like to share the blocks. They each wanted to have the most and the best blocks.

One day, they found a big box of new blocks in the corner. They ran to the box and opened it. Inside, there were many colorful and shiny blocks. They were incredible! They had different shapes and sizes and patterns. Ben and Lily wanted to touch them all.

But they did not want to share them. They both reached for the same block at the same time. They pulled and tugged and shouted. "Mine!" "No, mine!" They did not yield. They did not let go.

The block was too slippery and too heavy. It slipped from their hands and fell on the floor. It broke into many pieces. Ben and Lily gasped. They felt sad and sorry. They had broken the incredible block.

They looked at each other. They felt bad. They said, "I'm sorry." They hugged. They decided to share the blocks. They picked up the pieces and put them back in the box. They took out some other blocks and started to build together. They had fun. They were happy. They learned to yield.

Once there was a boy. He was three years old and he liked to play. One day he was in the living room, he saw something weird on the sofa. It was a big plastic box, with lots of different colors. The boy blinked.

He walked over to the plastic box, and he touched it. It felt funny and he could hear something moving inside. He blinked and he waited. Then, something popped out of the top of the box!

It was a weird, blue creature. It had funny eyes and big ears. The creature blinked and the little boy blinked too. They stared at each other for a few seconds, until the creature hopped off the sofa and ran away.

The boy blinked and smiled. He had just seen something really weird and really cool. He ran to tell his family about this strange plastic creature. And that's the story of the weird plastic box!

Lila and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big slide. Lila wants to go first. She climbs up the ladder and sits on the slide. Ben waits at the bottom.

"Ready, set, go!" Lila says. She pushes herself down the slide. She goes very fast. She feels the wind in her hair. She smiles. She sees Ben at the bottom. He claps his hands.

"Wow, Lila, you are so brave!" Ben says. "Can I try?"

"Sure, Ben, it is fun!" Lila says. She helps him climb up the ladder. He sits on the slide. He looks at the park. He sees the trees, the flowers, the birds. He sees a distant hill. He sees something shiny on the hill. He wonders what it is.

"Ready, set, go!" Ben says. He pushes himself down the slide. He goes very fast. He feels the wind in his face. He laughs. He sees Lila at the bottom. She waves her hand.

"Wow, Ben, you are so fast!" Lila says. "Did you see the shiny thing on the hill?"

"Yes, I did, Lila. What is it?" Ben says.

"I don't know, Ben. Maybe it is a treasure. Do you want to go and see?" Lila says.

"Yes, I do, Lila. Let's go!" Ben says.

They run to the hill. They climb up the hill. They find the shiny thing. It is a big jar. It is full of olives. They like olives. They are hungry.

"Look, Lila, it is a jar of olives!" Ben says.

"Yummy, Ben, let's eat some!" Lila says.

They open the jar. They take some olives. They eat them. They are delicious. They share them. They are happy.

They have a picnic on the hill. They see the park. They see the slide. They see their friends. They wave to them. They are glad. They have a good day.

Once there was a wild figure. She was made of fire and she loved to burn.
She burned through a forest and people watched as she ran by. She ran across the sky and burned through the clouds.

The figure burned until she ran out of energy. She could not burn anymore. Then she found a big pond. She jumped in and played in the cool water.

The people watching were so happy that the wild figure was happy and safe. They cheered and clapped as she splashed around.
The little figure smiled and felt better after her long journey of burning.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty girl named Lily. She loved to play with her drum every day. One day, she was playing her drum in the park when a boy came up to her. "Can I play with your drum?" asked the boy. "Sure!" said Lily.

The boy rubbed his hands together and started to play the drum. Lily was happy that she made a new friend. They played together for a while until the boy accidentally hit the drum too hard and it broke. "Oh no!" said Lily. "My drum is broken."

Lily was sad because she loved her drum so much. She went home crying, and her mom asked her what happened. "My drum is broken," said Lily. Her mom tried to fix it, but it was too broken to be fixed. Lily was very sad and missed her drum very much. The end.

Once there was a mom and her daughter. The daughter was very independent. She saw mom cooking food on the stove and wanted to cook too! So mom gave her a small piece of dough and showed her how to cook it.

The daughter was so pleased with her work. But then something strange happened - the dough started to shrink! It kept getting smaller and smaller.

The daughter was so surprised. She asked her mom what was happening, and mom explained that heat from the stove was making the dough shrink. She showed her daughter how to adjust the stove to make sure the dough didn't get too small.

The daughter practiced and became even more independent. She was so proud of herself that she could now cook her own food on the stove.

The end.

Mia and Leo were playing in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide. Mia saw a big hill with a lot of flowers. She wanted to go there and smell them.

"Come on, Leo, let's go to the hill!" she said.

"OK, Mia, but be careful. There might be bees there," Leo said.

They ran to the hill and started to climb. Mia saw a yellow flower that looked like a star. She reached for it, but something moved in the grass. It was a hairy animal with long ears and a fluffy tail. It was a bunny!

"Look, Leo, a bunny!" Mia said.

"Wow, Mia, it's so cute!" Leo said.

They wanted to pet the bunny, but the bunny was scared. It sprang away and ran to a hole. Mia and Leo followed it, but they could not see it anymore.

"Where did it go?" Mia asked.

"Maybe it went to its home," Leo said.

They looked around and saw a lot of holes in the ground. They wondered if the bunny had friends and family there. They also saw some rice plants growing near the holes. They remembered that their mom had cooked rice for lunch.

"Maybe the bunnies eat rice," Mia said.

"Maybe they do," Leo said.

They decided to leave some rice for the bunnies. They took some from their lunch box and put it near the holes. They hoped the bunnies would like it.

"Bye, bunnies, we hope you come out and play with us next time," Mia said.

"Bye, bunnies, we hope you enjoy the rice," Leo said.

They waved to the holes and went back to the park. They did not know that the bunnies were watching them from their home. They were happy and grateful for the rice. They thought Mia and Leo were very nice. They wanted to be their friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. He was just 3 years old, and one day he noticed that some of the clouds in the sky were doing something strange. They were shooting all sorts of different colours of water into the air!

Jack was very curious, so he asked his mom what was happening. His mom smiled and said: "Those are called rainbows! It's when the sun shines on the water droplets in the sky and they spray into colours. It's like a paintbrush!

Jack was so excited. He loved rainbows! That day it was raining, and he kept looking up, hoping to see another one. But then he noticed something else.

The rain was dripping down to the earth and making little puddles, but then he saw something completely different. Some of the puddles were spraying up into the air! They were spraying in different directions like little fountains! Jack was amazed.

He asked his mom what had happened, and she laughed and said "That's called evaporation! The water heats up and turns into a gas, and when that happens, it sprays up into the air!"

Jack couldn't believe it. He'd learned something new about the earth, and he loved it!

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lily. She loved wintertime because she got to wear her warm jacket. One day, Lily decided to go out in the snow with her friends.

There was a large icy hill and everyone was so excited to go sledding. Lily was brave and she went down the hill first.

Suddenly, while she was at the bottom of the hill, Lily heard a loud *crack* sound. Lily's jacket had broken! Tears filled her eyes.

Lily's friends told her, "Don't worry, Lily. You should have listened to your mom and not gone sledding with us. Now, you'll have to go back home and tell your mom."

The moral of the story is that sometimes it's best to listen to grown-ups. They give good advice and it is important to follow it.

Ben and Lily were playing in the garden. They liked to splash in the pool and make bubbles with the soap. They had a big towel to dry themselves when they were done.

But then, Ben saw a butterfly. He wanted to catch it and see its colors. He ran after it, leaving the towel on the grass. Lily did not see him go. She was busy making a big bubble.

When Lily looked up, she could not find Ben. She called his name, but he did not answer. She felt scared and lonely. She wanted her brother to come back. She wrapped the towel around her and started to cry.

Ben followed the butterfly to the fence. He saw a hole under it. He thought the butterfly went through it. He crawled under the fence and found himself in a dark alley. He did not see the butterfly anymore. He saw a big dog. The dog was angry and barked at him. Ben was afraid and tried to run away. But the dog was faster and bit him. Ben screamed and dropped the towel.

Lily heard Ben scream. She ran to the fence and looked through the hole. She saw the dog and the towel. She did not see Ben. She thought the dog ate him. She was very sad and screamed too. She wanted her brother back. She wanted the dog to disappear. But the dog did not disappear. The dog took the towel and ran away. Lily was left alone in the garden, with no brother and no towel. She cried and cried.

Once upon a time there was a puppy. His collar was very important. One day he went to play outside. As he was running around he accidentally slipped on some mud. He fell down very quickly. He looked up and noticed his collar was missing. He started whining and crying, looking for it everywhere. He looked under the chairs and tables, but still couldn't find it.

Suddenly he saw a cat sitting in a tree. It had his collar in its mouth. The puppy was very happy. The cat jumped down and handed him his collar.

He was thankful and put it back on his neck. He then went back to playing, never to forget how important his collar was.

Ben and Lily are playing in the farm. They like to run and jump in the wheat field. The wheat is tall and yellow and soft. They pretend they are lions and tigers and roar at each other.

"Roar! I am a big lion and I will catch you!" Ben says.

"Roar! I am a fast tiger and you can't catch me!" Lily says.

They chase each other and laugh. They are having fun.

But then the sky becomes dark and cloudy. They hear a loud boom. It is thunder. They see a bright flash. It is lightning. They feel drops of water on their faces. It is rain.

"Oh no! It is raining! We have to go back to the house!" Ben says.

"Yes, we have to go! The rain will make us wet and cold!" Lily says.

They run to the house as fast as they can. The rain becomes heavier and heavier. They are wet and muddy. They reach the door and knock.

"Mom! Dad! We are here! Let us in!" Ben says.

"Mom! Dad! We are sorry! We are wet and dirty!" Lily says.

Mom and Dad open the door and hug them. They are not angry. They are happy to see them.

"Come in, come in! You are safe and warm now!" Mom says.

"Let's get you some dry clothes and some hot cocoa!" Dad says.

They close the door and go inside. They are glad to be home. They love their mom and dad. They love the farm. They love the wheat. But they don't love the rain.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy went on a walk with his family. While they were walking, Timmy observed a little bird in a tree. He pointed and said, "Look, I spot a bird!" His family stopped to look and they saw the bird too. Timmy was so happy that he could observe the bird and share it with his family. They continued their walk and Timmy couldn't wait to spot more animals along the way.

Lily was a little girl who liked to examine everything. She would look at the flowers, the bugs, the books, and the toys with her big eyes. She wanted to learn about the world.

One day, she was in her room and she saw something new on the ceiling. It was a shiny star that her mom had put there. Lily was curious and wanted to examine it. She climbed on her bed and reached for the star.

"Be careful, Lily!" her mom said from the door. "You might fall and hurt yourself. The star is just for looking, not for touching."

But Lily did not listen. She wanted to touch the star and see how it felt. She stretched her arm and grabbed the star. But the star was not strong. It broke off the ceiling and fell on the floor. Lily fell too and bumped her head.

"Ow!" Lily cried. "Mommy, help!"

Her mom ran to her and hugged her. She checked her head and saw a small bump. She kissed it and said, "You are lucky, Lily. It is not a big hurt. But you should have listened to me. The star was not for touching. It was for making your room pretty and bright. Now it is broken and you are sad."
