Lily looked at the broken star and felt sorry. She said, "I'm sorry, Mommy. I was silly. I wanted to examine the star, but I should have looked with my eyes, not with my hands."

Her mom smiled and said, "It's okay, Lily. I forgive you. You are a smart girl and you like to examine things. But you have to be careful and respectful. Some things are not for touching. They are for admiring. And some things are for touching. They are for playing. You have to know the difference."

Lily nodded and said, "I understand, Mommy. Thank you for teaching me. Can we fix the star?"

Her mom said, "Maybe we can. But first, let's have some lunch. You must be hungry after all that examining."

Lily said, "Yes, Mommy. I'm hungry. Can we have some soup and bread?"

Her mom said, "Sure, Lily. Let's go to the kitchen and have some soup and bread. And maybe a cookie for dessert."

Lily smiled and said, "Yay! I love soup and bread and cookies. And I love you, Mommy."

Her mom said, "I love you too, Lily. You are my sweet star."

Little Farleigh was walking along the sidewalk on a sunny day, looking from side to side at the sights as she went. She watched birds flying in the sky, admired flowers blooming in the garden, and delighted at the funny faces of passersby.

Suddenly, she heard a voice calling out from behind a tall tree: "Hello there! Can you help me? I am too tired to move."

Startled, Farleigh took a step back - she had not expected to encounter a talking tree. But the tree seemed friendly, so she decided to approach it. From behind the tree's large trunk walked out a little rabbit, who looked even more tired than the tree.

Farleigh was filled with curiosity, but also a bit of fear. She asked the rabbit hesitantly, "what happened?" Without a trace of fear the little rabbit replied, "I was playing hide and seek with my friends. We were so busy having fun, we lost track of time. Now I can't find them, and I am too tired to go look for them."

Little Farleigh thought for a moment, then she smiled and said, "Let's surrender and take a break! We'll look for them after we have some rest." The rabbit and the tree smiled in agreement.

They kept playing in the fountain until they got too wet, so they decided to go home. On the way they talked and laughed about all the fun they had.

Every summer, the family goes to a special camp. They stay in a small cabin in the woods, and they have a lot of fun! The children play in the sunshine and explore the meadow and woods. There are so many wonderful things to see and do. The days are mild and the sun is warm.

At night, the family gathers around the campfire. They toast marshmallows and tell stories. Everyone loves the songs and jokes. Then, when the stars come out, the family falls asleep in their cabin.

In the mornings, they wake up to the birds singing. The family plays all day and has a great time. And at night they gather round the still-glowing campfire and talk, until it is time to go to sleep again.

The family is sad when their stay at camp comes to an end, but they know they will return next year.

Ben likes to print. He has a big box of paper and many colors of paint. He dips his hands in the paint and makes handprints on the paper. He also uses a rod to make lines and circles. He thinks his prints are very pretty.

One day, Ben wants to print a gift for his mom. He finds a big sheet of paper and some red paint. He prints a big heart with his hands and writes "I love you" with the rod. He is very proud of his print and wants to show it to his mom.

He runs to the living room, where his mom is sitting on the couch. She is reading a book and looks very comfortable. Ben says, "Mom, look what I made for you!" He holds up his print and smiles. His mom sees his print and smiles too. She says, "Wow, Ben, that is a beautiful print! Thank you so much! I love you too!" She hugs him and kisses him. She puts his print on the wall and says, "That is the best gift ever!"

Ben is very happy. He loves his mom and his print. He thinks printing is fun and easy. He wants to print more things for his mom and dad and friends. He thinks they will like his prints too. He goes back to his box of paper and paint and prints some more. He is a good printer.

Nina wanted a new bike. Her parents said they would give her one if she was good. She was very excited and waited patiently for them to give it to her.

When the special day came, her dad brought her a shiny steel bike. She was so happy and couldn't wait to ride it.

Her dad said he went to the shop to find the perfect bike. He looked at lots of different ones but he saw this one and thought it was the best. It was available in many different colors but Nina chose a bright blue one.

Nina thanked her dad for the bike as she hopped on and began to ride. She was so happy and couldn't wait to show her friends her new steel bike.

Once there was a bird. The bird wanted to soar in the sky. Every day he spread out his wings, and tried to fly. He flapped and he fussed, but no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't take off!

Then one day, the bird got an idea. He found an envelope, and put it on his back. He ran and ran until he reached a cliff. He spread his wings, and jumped off the cliff!

The bird felt the wind pushing the envelope, and he soared high in the sky! As his wings moved, the breeze moved the envelope. The bird sang and smiled!

But then, some bad things happened. The wind turned, and the envelope started to fall. The bird couldn't soar as high anymore, and he had to come back down to the ground. But despite this, the bird kept on trying, until one day he soared in the sky again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to drink hot chocolate from her favorite mug. One day, she realized that her mug was missing. She looked everywhere for it, but couldn't find it. Lily felt very sad and lonely without her mug.

She asked her mommy and daddy if they had seen it, but they hadn't. Lily started to cry because she loved her mug so much. Then, her little brother came along and said, "Look Lily, your mug is right here!" It was on the top shelf where Lily couldn't reach it. She was so happy to have her mug back and gave her little brother a big hug. From then on, Lily made sure to put her mug in a safe place where she could always find it.

Jill and Tom were friends who liked to play with blocks. They had many blocks of different colors and shapes. They could build towers, houses, bridges and anything they wanted. They had fun making their own world with blocks.

One day, they decided to play with blocks in the basement. The basement was dark and cold, but they brought a lamp and a blanket. They found a big box of blocks that they had never seen before. They opened the box and saw many charming blocks. They had stars, hearts, flowers and animals on them. They were shiny and pretty.

Jill and Tom were very happy. They started to build with the charming blocks. They made a castle, a garden, a zoo and a rocket. They were so busy that they did not hear the door close behind them. They did not see the sign that said "Danger: Do not touch".

The charming blocks were not really blocks. They were bombs. They had wires and timers and explosives inside them. They were left by bad people who wanted to hurt others. The bad people had forgotten about the bombs, but they had set them to go off soon.

Jill and Tom did not know that. They kept playing with the charming blocks. They did not notice the beeping sound that got louder and faster. They did not see the red light that flashed on the bombs. They did not feel the heat that grew around them.

Suddenly, there was a big boom. The charming blocks exploded. The basement was filled with fire and smoke and noise. Jill and Tom screamed. They tried to crawl away, but it was too late. The fire burned them. The smoke choked them. The noise deafened them. They could not escape. They died.

The end.

Yesterday, a lazy farmer named Bob had a lot of work to do. But he was too lazy to do it, so he just stayed in bed. Then he heard something. It was a loud bang! He looked outside and saw a beautiful deer running away. Bob had just seen a hunter shoot his gun at the deer. He quickly got dressed and went out to the field. He scolded the hunter for shooting animals and told him never to do it again. And from then on, Bob made sure he was never lazy, so he would always be ready to help animals when they needed it.

Olly woke up one morning and wanted a cup of coffee. He asked his mom for the coffee and she said yes.

He went to the kitchen and opened the cupboard. He found the coffee but it was messy! He had to spend a few minutes picking it up so it was all neat.

Once the coffee was tidied up, Olly made the coffee himself. He put in the milk, sugar and coffee beans. Then he pressed the button and waited.

When it was ready, the coffee smelled good. Olly drank it while standing in the kitchen. He liked the taste and thanked his mom for the coffee.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to paint and make pretty pictures. One day, she saw a patch on her wall that was not pretty. She wanted to paint over it to make it pretty like her pictures.

Lily asked her mommy for help, but her mommy was busy and said, "Not now, Lily. Maybe later." Lily was sad, but she still wanted to paint the patch. She got her paint and brushes ready and started to paint the patch.

But, the paint was not dry yet and Lily accidentally touched it. The paint got on her pretty dress and she cried. Her mommy came and said, "I told you to wait, Lily. Now your dress is ruined."

The moral of the story is to always listen to your mommy and wait until you are ready to do something.

Once upon a time, there was a musician. He was a regular musician who played music every day. One day, he went outside to see the pretty flowers. He saw a butterfly flying and it made him happy. The musician loved to see the beautiful things in nature. He went back inside and played his music again. The music was so pretty that even the butterfly came to listen. The musician was happy that his music made others happy too. The end.

Mia and her mommy were in the bedroom. Mia was painting a big picture for her mommy. It was a beautiful painting with lots of colors.

"Mommy, do you like it?" Mia asked.

"Oh, Mia, it's so beautiful! You used lots of colors," her mommy said.

Mia was very proud of her painting. She put the painting on her mommy's dress hanger. It was so tidy and pretty.

But then, Mia's sister came into the bedroom. She did not mind the painting at all. She just wanted to take the hanger. She grabbed it and started to run away.

Mia tried to get it back but it was too late. Her sister ran away and kept the hanger. Mia was very sad. Her painting was no longer tidy and pretty. She wanted to keep it and show it off to all her friends, but it was gone.

Mia was so sad that she did not feel like painting anymore. She learned a lesson that day: always mind your things and take care of them.

Once upon a time, there was a big lake. Many ducks used to swim in it. One day, two ducks started to fight. They were angry with each other. They flapped their wings and quacked loudly.

Suddenly, they fell into the lake. They started to splash and swim. They forgot about their fight. They were happy to swim in the cool water.

After a while, they came out of the lake. They were wet but proud of themselves. They had swum very well. They looked at each other and smiled. They were no longer angry. They were friends again.

Once upon a time, there was a festival. Everyone was excited and speeded about, having lots of fun.

Annabelle was at the festival with her mom and dad. She wanted to try something new and delicious, so she went to the food stall. She saw lots of interesting food, but the one that caught her eye was a sour treat. She excitedly asked her mom if she could try it.

Her mom said yes, and Annabelle eagerly took a bite. The sour treat was so tangy and delicious! She couldn't help but speed away and eat some more.

Annabelle had a great time at the festival, and she couldn't wait to go back next year. She was so happy that she got to try something new and tasty.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys. One day, he saw a large ball in the park.

Timmy: "Wow! That ball is so big! I want to play with it."

A little girl named Sarah was playing with the ball.

Timmy: "Can I play with your ball, please?"

Sarah: "Sure! I love sharing my toys with others."

Timmy was so happy to play with the large ball. He kicked it and threw it in the air. Sarah and Timmy played together for a long time.

Timmy: "Thank you for sharing your ball with me. I had so much fun playing with you."

Sarah: "You're welcome! I love making new friends."

From that day on, Timmy and Sarah played together often and became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play outside. One day, she found a dirty stray dog in her backyard. "Hi there, little pup. Do you want to come inside and sleep in my bed?" Lily asked the dog. The dog wagged its tail and followed Lily into her house.

Lily's mom was surprised to see a new furry friend in the house. "Who is this little guy?" she asked. "He's a stray dog I found outside. Can he sleep in my bed tonight?" Lily replied. "I don't know if that's a good idea, Lily. We don't know if he's clean or not. But, I'll lead him to the backyard and give him some food and water," her mom said.

After the dog ate and drank, he fell asleep in his new dog bed outside. Lily watched him sleep and said, "I'm glad we found you, little pup. You're not dirty anymore." The dog opened his eyes and licked Lily's hand. "Woof woof!" he barked, happy to have a new friend.

Once there was a little girl named Jill. She was only three years old, but she loved to measure things. Every day she would measure the height of her mom, her dad and her brother.

One day, Jill's dad told her to measure a bar of soap. She was so excited. She grabbed the bar of soap and a ruler and got to work.

But it was a terrible challenge. The soap was slippery and wet, so it was very difficult to measure! Jill kept trying, but she just couldn't get a good measurement.

Eventually, Jill's mom found her. She helped Jill to measure the soap, and it only took a few minutes!

Jill was so happy. She had really learned something new - and it was all thanks to the help of her mom. From that day on, she never thought measuring soap would be a terrible challenge again.

Once upon a time, there was an old kangaroo who lived in the forest. One day, the old kangaroo met a little girl. The little girl said, "I need a friend to play with. Do you want to be my friend?" The old kangaroo said, "Yes, I need a friend too."

The little girl and the old kangaroo played together every day. They hopped and jumped and had so much fun. One day, the little girl said, "You're an old kangaroo. Do you need to rest?" The old kangaroo said, "Yes, I need to rest my legs."

The little girl and the old kangaroo sat under a tree and talked. The old kangaroo said, "I'm so happy I have a friend like you. I don't feel old when I'm playing with you." The little girl said, "I'm happy too. You're the best kangaroo friend I could ever have." From that day on, the little girl and the old kangaroo were the best of friends.

Once there was a young boy who loved to whistle. Every day the boy went outside and stood in the sunshine and whistled. The boy's whistling was so beautiful that soon the birds joined in and sang along.

One day the young boy decided he wanted to eat something sour. He went to the shop and bought some lemons. As he was walking home, he ate one of the juicy lemons. The boy was surprised that the lemon was so sour! He licked his lips, which made him laugh.

After eating the lemons, the boy went back outside and whistled. He smiled with delight when he heard the birds singing back to him. He had made a lot of friends and it made the young boy very happy.

Once there was a boy. His name was Bob. Bob was very glad because he was going to bake a thing. First, he got the ingredients and put them all together in a bowl. Then he mixed them together until they became a big yummy dough. He put the dough in a special oven and waited and waited. After a while, the thing smelled so good that his mouth watered. Finally, the thing was done. Bob was so glad when it was pulled out of the oven. He ate it by himself and it was delicious! He was so happy he even did a little dance.

Once upon a time there was a big, blue ship. It sailed across the sea each day and smiled at the birds that flew by. But one day the ship got hurt. It stopped smiling and its sails drooped down. All of the fish and birds that had been its friends felt very sad.

The ship wanted to get better, so it sailed away and looked for help. But everyone it asked for help said no. The ship sailed for many days and felt very lonely.

Finally, the ship found a special place called Home. It was a happy place where a boy and girl lived. They made the ship feel better. They gave it a hug and put special bandages on its hurt.

The ship was so happy to have found Home! It didn't want to leave, but knew it had to. The ship left with a smile, but also with a feeling of missing the boy and girl. The ship didn't want to go, and it knew that the boy and girl missed it too.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl named Izzy. Izzy loved to play in her jungle. Every day, she would run and swing amongst the trees, make tiny hiding places in the bushes and even pretend to roar like one of the animals. It was so much fun!

One day, Izzy was so excited to go to her jungle that she ran there before her mom could tell her goodbye. She had the best time ever playing there!

But suddenly, she heard a loud scream! Izzy was scared and ran back home. When she saw her mom, she screamed and hugged her tightly.

Her mom was happy to see her, but saw that Izzy was untidy. She took her inside and asked her what happened. Izzy was too scared to say what she heard, so he mom looked around in the jungle. She soon noticed that one of the animals had made a realy tidy nest.

"That's alright Izzy," said her mom, giving her a hug. "I'm glad you're safe."

Izzy was happy to be back home. She knew now that her jungle was not only fun but safe, too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she went on a walk with her mommy. They saw a big, brown dog. Lily pointed and said, "Look, Mommy! A dog!"

Her mommy said, "Yes, that's right. But we need to be careful because some dogs can be dangerous."

Lily didn't understand what "dangerous" meant, but she knew it was something bad. They continued on their walk and found a spot with lots of flowers. Lily loved flowers! She ran to pick one and her mommy said, "Wait, Lily. Look before you pick. There might be a bee."

Lily looked closely and saw a bee on the flower. She said, "Oh no, a bee! That's dangerous!"

Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, that's right. But if we are careful and look before we touch, we can avoid the dangerous spots." From that day on, Lily always looked before she pointed or picked.

Once upon a time there was a man and his wife who liked to take naps together. One day the man was feeling tired, so he lay down and closed his eyes. His wife had other plans though, and she said she was not tired. The man got angry, and he told her to go and find something else to do.

So the wife decided to leave the house. She walked down the street, but she didn't get very far. Suddenly, she tripped and fell, and she hurt herself really badly. She lay on the ground, crying and feeling sad.

The man heard her cries, and he ran to her. But it was too late. The wife's injuries were too severe, and she didn't survive. The man was so sad and hurt, he could not stop crying. Sadness filled his heart, for he would never see his wife again.

Once upon a time a little girl called True was playing in her garden. She saw a big, dangerous bee. It frightened her and she ran away. True was so scared that she quickly went inside her house and told her mommy about the bee.

Her mommy knew how to keep True safe. She gently reminded True that if she saw any more dangerous bees, she should just stay away from them and tell an adult. True nodded her head and promised to tell her mommy if she ever saw one again.

On the way back to her garden, True was reminded by her mommy to stay away from any dangerous things. True was brave and ran into the garden, knowing that she was safe. True was reminded to be careful and to never forget her mommy's advice.

True looked around the garden, but she never saw a dangerous bee again.

One day, a little boy named Timmy went to the park with his mom. Timmy loved going to the park because there were lots of things to do. He liked to swing on the swings and slide down the slide.

While Timmy was playing, he saw a man with a big motor. The motor made lots of noise and Timmy thought it was interesting. He went up to the man and said, "Hi! What are you doing?"

The man replied, "I'm fixing the swings. The motor helps me do my job." Timmy wanted to help too, so he said, "Can I help you fix the swings?"

The man smiled and said, "Sure! You can help me hold the tools." Timmy was so excited to help. He held the tools while the man fixed the swings. When they were done, Timmy said, "Thank you for letting me help. That was fun!" And the man said, "You're welcome. It was nice to have some help."

Once there were two friends, Sarah and Lucy, who decided to go for a walk in the woods. As they were walking around, Sarah saw something shiny in the dirt. It was a skull! The two friends stopped to look at it. Lucy asked Sarah, "What could it have been?" Sarah wasn't sure, but she had a feeling the answer was unknown.

The two friends kept walking around the woods and then they saw a dark figure. It was a man, but they weren't sure who he was. He seemed to be acting strangely. Sarah suggested they should leave quickly, but Lucy thought they should stay to see what the man was doing.

The man saw that Sarah and Lucy had spotted him, and he began to run away. The two friends decided to follow him as they were curious to see where he was going. The man was leading them further and further away from the woods and into an unknown part of the forest.

Suddenly, the man stopped and let out a loud laugh. He then disappeared, leaving Sarah and Lucy alone in the dark forest. They had no way to get back home and didn't know what to do.

The moral of this story is to always be cautious and trust your gut feeling. Sarah had a feeling something wasn't right, but Lucy overruled her and put them in danger.

Once upon a time, there lived a prince. he was looking for the right princess to marry.

One day, he found a beautiful princess in a chamber. She had long hair and wore a thick dress.

The prince was so happy he asked her to marry him. The princess was also very happy and agreed to marry him.

They had a wonderful wedding and were very happy together. They lived happily ever after in the chamber with the thick walls.

The End.

Anna loves parades. She likes to see the big balloons, the loud music, and the people in costumes. She always wants to go to the parades with her mom and dad.

One day, Anna hears that there is a parade in the park. She asks her mom and dad if they can go. They say yes, and they get ready to leave. Anna puts on her hat, her coat, and her boots. She is very excited.

They walk to the park, and they find a good spot to watch the parade. Anna sees the balloons, the music, and the costumes. She claps and cheers. She is very happy.

But then, she sees something that makes her sad. She sees a little boy who has no hat, no coat, and no boots. He is shivering and crying. He has no mom and dad with him. He is alone.

Anna feels sorry for the boy. She realizes that he is cold and lonely. She realizes that she is lucky to have a hat, a coat, and boots. She realizes that she is lucky to have a mom and dad who love her.

She decides to do something nice for the boy. She takes off her hat, and she gives it to him. She says, "Here, you can have my hat. It will keep you warm." The boy smiles and says, "Thank you." He puts on the hat.

Anna feels good. She has done something easy, but kind. She has made a new friend. She watches the parade with the boy, and they both enjoy it. They are both happy.

Danny was a 3 year old boy who lived in a neighbourhood with lots of trees and grass. He loved to play outside.

One sunny day, Danny was playing with his friends when he noticed something sparkling in the grass. He picked it up to have a better look and realized it was a cell phone. He was so excited about his discovery and started to play with it.

Suddenly, the cell phone screen fell off and the phone was broken. Danny started to cry. His friends gathered around him and tried to console him.

Danny soon felt better, and his friends had a great idea. They decided to give him a surprise and build Danny a secret fort out of sticks and stones.

Danny was overjoyed and spent the rest of the day playing in the fort. He was so happy that he had realized his broken cell phone wasn't the end of the world and that he still had his friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy was three years old, and she loved to play outside.

One morning, Daisy was outside playing when she noticed something special. It was the sunrise! It was so pretty and orange.

Daisy said, "Mama, can I stay outside and watch the sunrise?"

Her mama said, "Sure Daisy. Just don't be too scary when it gets dark, okay?"

So Daisy stayed outside and watched the sunrise. It was so beautiful! Soon, it was dark, and Daisy was getting a little scared.

But Daisy was brave. She stayed outside and watched the sunrise, even though it was a little scary. And when it was over, she had the best day ever!

Once upon a time, there was a big, heavy truck. The truck liked to drive fast. One day, the truck broke down. It needed help.

A nice mechanic came to help the truck. He had a big toolbox. The mechanic worked hard to fix the truck. He asked his friend, a small car, to join him. The car was happy to help.

Together, the mechanic and the car fixed the heavy truck. The truck was so happy. They all became good friends. They played and drove around together. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat sweets and candies. One day, she went to the candy store with her mom.

Lily looked at all the candies and chocolates with different colors and shapes. Her mom suggested that she should try a candy with a bumpy texture. Lily was not sure, but her mom said it might be tasty.

Lily tried the candy and it was delicious! She loved the bumpy texture and the tasty flavor. She thanked her mom for suggesting it to her. From that day on, Lily always tried new candies with different textures and flavors.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sara. One day, Sara had a brilliant idea. She looked around her garden until her eyes rested on a big tree. Grinning, she excitedly grabbed a big net and ran to the tree.

"I'm going to throw the net up in the tree and climb it," she said, throwing the big net over the tree's branches.

Suddenly, the net got stuck in the branches and Sara got a bit dizzy. She tried to get the network out of the tree, but no matter what she did, it stayed stuck.

"Oh, no!" she said.

Sara looked around for help when she spotted her dad looking at her with a smile. She ran to him and he gave her a big hug.

"Don't worry, darling," he said. "I will help you get the network out of the tree".

Sara's dad grabbed a ladder and carefully climbed up the tree. He carefully started untangling the net from the branches until it finally came free. When Sara saw the network in her dad's hands she felt so happy that she jumped around and celebrated.

"Yay! I got my net back," she said, feeling dizzy with joy.

John the cat was very playful. He would spend hours playing on his own chasing a ball or performing amazing flips and jumps. One day, he decided to do something special.

John ran through the doorway and trotted outside. He spotted a pile of salt on the ground and he found it fascinating. He sniffed it, licked it and sat down in the middle of the pile. He began to perform.

John rolled around, jumped and danced - all while surrounded by salt! As he performed, the salt sprayed around him like snow. John felt so happy.

He stayed there all day, performing and having fun. When he was done, he thanked the salt for such a wonderful day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was walking in the forest and she saw a peach. She thought it was very nice so she wanted to have it. She asked the peach if she could have it and it said yes. The peach offered to come with her.

The girl was very happy and she started to walk back home with the peach. But it started to rain and it became very wet. The girl didn't want the peach to get wet so she put it into her pocket. She kept it safe until she was home again.

When the girl and the peach arrived at home, the girl was very happy. She gave the peach some water and she ate it. It was the sweetest thing she ever tasted. She was very satisfied and she said thank you to the peach.

Once upon a time, there was a tall girl. She loved to drive. Every day, she would get in her car, turn the key and start driving.

One day, she was driving and saw a 3 year old boy. He was watching her drive and she smiled at him. The boy said to her, "Can I ride with you?"

The girl thought it was a great idea and invited the boy to get in the car. She asked him, "Where do you want to go?"

The boy said, "I want to ride around town!"

The girl took him on a drive. She showed him all the cool things in town, like the tree with the swing, the store with the ice cream, and the park with the slide.

The little boy was so happy. When they were done driving, he said to the girl, "Thank you so much for taking me on a drive!"

The tall girl smiled and said, "You're welcome." And with that, they drove off into the sunset.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a bulb that she loved to water every day. One day, Lily's mom said to her, "Lily, can you listen to me for a minute? We need to go to the store to buy some food." Lily was eager to go to the store with her mom.

At the store, Lily saw her friend Timmy. Timmy said, "Lily, what do you have there?" Lily showed him her bulb and said, "I water it every day." Timmy said, "Wow, you are a good gardener!"

When Lily got home, she watered her bulb again and said, "I love my bulb. It makes me happy." Her mom listened to her and said, "I'm glad you love your bulb, Lily. It's important to take care of the things we love."

Once upon a time, there was a gray cat named Tom. He liked to play with water. One sunny day, Tom found a big bowl of water in the kitchen. He was very happy.

Tom started to play with the water. He used his paw to splash the water all around. Soon, the floor was all wet. Tom didn't know that the floor was now a big mess.

Tom's friend, a little girl named Sue, came into the kitchen. She saw the wet floor and said, "Oh no, Tom! The floor is all soaked!" Sue got a towel and helped Tom clean the wet floor. They both laughed and had fun while cleaning. And from that day, Tom learned not to make a mess with water.

One day, a yellow bird flew over a big forest. He saw many other birds of different colors and shapes. He wanted to make friends with them, but they did not like him. They said he was too bright and loud, and they chased him away.

The yellow bird was very sad. He flew and flew until he saw a big castle. He landed on a window and looked inside. He saw a king sitting on a throne. The king was wearing a yellow crown and a yellow cloak. He looked very lonely and bored.

The yellow bird knocked on the glass and said, "Hello, king. Can I be your friend?"

The king heard the bird and looked up. He smiled and said, "Hello, yellow bird. You are very pretty and brave. Yes, you can be my friend. Come in and sit with me."

The yellow bird flew inside and perched on the king's shoulder. He sang a happy song and made the king laugh. The king said, "You are the best friend I ever had. You make me feel happy and warm. Will you stay with me?"

The yellow bird said, "Yes, king. I will stay with you. You are very kind and wise. We are both yellow and we both like to sing. We are a good match."

The king and the yellow bird became very close. They shared stories and secrets and jokes. They united their hearts and their voices. They made the castle a happier place. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a wild dog. He was very slow but he liked to jump. He was so slow he had to rest a lot and he was always tired. So one day he decided he wanted to jump more.

He ran and ran, until he reached a really big field. He got really excited and jumped high in the sky. It was so much fun!

The wild dog kept jumping until he was really tired. He then stopped to rest. Suddenly, he heard a noise. It was a rabbit! The rabbit jumped over a log and the wild dog chased him. The wild dog ran slow but he kept jumping over rocks and trees.

Eventually he wore himself out and had to stop. He looked around. He had done lots of jumping and he was so proud of himself. From that day on, he knew that he could do anything with just a bit of practice. He realized that slow and steady wins the race.

Once upon a time there was a boy. He was 3 years old. His name was Tommy. Tommy was troubled. He had a toy gun. It was his favorite toy.

One night Tommy was playing with his gun. He wanted to keep it safe. So he decided to put it in a box.

But Tommy accidentally left the box outside in the rain. The next morning, Tommy realized the gun was wet. He started crying and his mommy came over to help.

Mommy used an old towel to dry the gun. She shined it and cleaned it up until it was just like new. Tommy was very happy and his troubles went away.

And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, Tim took a walk in the big forest. As he walked, he saw some furry animals. He felt so excited and couldn't believe how big the forest was.

Suddenly, Tim heard a loud noise. It was a big bear yawning! Tim was scared, but he stood very still. The bear didn't notice him.

Tim was relieved that the bear was so friendly. He kept on walking and soon came across a beautiful waterfall. He took a deep breath, feeling very content and peaceful.

As the sun began to set, Tim decided it was time to leave and walked back home. He had had a wonderful time in the big forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a toy cube that she loved to play with. One day, Lily noticed something weird about her cube. It had a funny pattern on it that she had never seen before.

Lily's mom came into the room and saw her daughter looking at the cube. She asked Lily what was wrong, and Lily showed her the weird pattern. They both looked at it for a while and then Lily's mom said, "Let's clap for your cube! It's still a fun toy even if it looks different now."

So, Lily and her mom clapped for the cube and then Lily went back to playing with it. She realized that even though it looked weird, it was still just as fun to play with as before. From that day on, Lily loved her cube even more because it was unique and special.

Once upon a time, there was an impressive navy. There were many big and brave ships. They sailed together in a group.

One day, the navy reached a beautiful beach. The ships stopped and the navy rested. The crew sat in the sand and enjoyed the sunny day. The sea was very blue and so was the sky.

The navy was so big that it filled the whole beach. Everyone couldn't help but marvel at the impressive sight.

After a while, the navy sailed away and all that was left was the beautiful beach. But everyone who had seen the impressive navy remembered it forever.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a creative little girl named Lily. She loved to look at the sky and paint it with her bright colors. The sky was her favorite thing to draw.

One sunny day, Lily went to the park to draw the sky. She brought her paper and colors, and found a nice spot to sit. She was so excited to start drawing the pretty sky. But, oh no! Lily forget to bring her favorite blue color for the sky.

Lily felt sad, but then she had a creative idea. She mixed her green and yellow colors together and made a new color. It was not the same blue, but it was still pretty. She used this new color to draw the sky.

In the end, Lily's picture of the sky was very beautiful. Everyone who saw her drawing loved it. Lily learned that even if you forget something, you can still be creative and make something nice. And from that day on, Lily never forget to be creative again.

There was a family that lived in a big house. One winter their town was gifted a magical snowman. He could lead people in special places. He knew how to find all kinds of wonderful things in nature.

The family took him into the woods one night and he showed them sparkling ice. They were amazed! He also showed them funny animals taking naps and fresh snowflakes that looked like stars.

He led them over a small bridge and they saw a wonderful rainbow. The rainbow was so pretty they all stood and looked at it in wonder. Then they all laughed and ran back across the bridge.

The snowman was so gifted that he made winter feel like a special, happy time. He showed the family all kinds of amazing things, and they enjoyed lots of fun together.

One sunny morning, Molly was playing outside with her toy airplane. The plane was red and shiny, and she made it fly around in the sky.

Molly's mom saw her daughter playing and brought her a cup of cold juice.

Molly said: "Thanks mommy!"

Molly's mom smiled and said: "You're welcome, honey! Would you like to play a game? Let's see if you can fly the plane and put the cups in an organized line.

Molly nodded and began flying the plane. She flew it over the cups and put them in a neat row.

Molly was so proud of herself. She flew the plane one more time and shouted: "Look, mommy! I did it!"

Molly's mom hugged her daughter and said: "You're so organized! I'm so proud of you!"

Lily was a humble girl who liked to help her mother. Every day, she would carry a basket of eggs from the hen house to the kitchen. She was careful not to drop any eggs or let the fox catch them.

One day, as she was walking with her basket, she saw a boy running towards her. He had a big smile on his face and a paper in his hand. He was her friend Tom, who lived in the next farm.

"Hi, Lily!" he shouted. "I have good news for you!"

"What is it, Tom?" Lily asked, curious.

"Look at this paper!" Tom said, showing her the paper. "It is a letter from your aunt. She is coming to visit you next week! She wants to see you and give you a present!"

Lily was very happy to hear the news. She loved her aunt, who lived far away in the city. She had not seen her for a long time.

"Wow, Tom, thank you for bringing me this news!" she said, hugging him. "You are a good friend!"

Tom blushed and smiled. He was glad to make Lily happy. He liked her a lot, but he was too shy to tell her.

"You are welcome, Lily!" he said. "Do you want to come with me to the market? We can buy some candy and see the animals!"

Lily nodded and agreed. She put her basket of eggs in a safe place and took Tom's hand. They ran together to the market, laughing and talking. They were both humble and happy children.

Once upon a time, there was a big whale. This whale was different. It could talk and solve problems.

One day, the whale met a little fish. The fish was sad. It could not find its mom. The whale wanted to help the fish. They went on a fun trip to find the fish's mom.

The whale and the fish asked other sea animals if they had seen the fish's mom. They solved the problem together. At last, they found the fish's mom. The fish was very happy. The whale, the fish, and the fish's mom became good friends. They all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat yummy food, especially cookies. One day, her mom made some delicious cookies and put them on the kitchen counter. But then, Lily saw a leak in the sink and wanted to help. She grabbed a towel and tried to reach the leak, but it was too high. Suddenly, her dad came and fixed the leak. Lily was so happy and ran back to the kitchen to eat her cookies. They tasted even more delicious because she had helped her family.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with his wagon. His wagon was red and it was light, so Tim could pull it easily.

One day, Tim went to the park with his wagon. He played with his friends and they had fun. But when it was time to go home, Tim realized that he had lost his favorite toy. He looked everywhere, but he couldn't find it.

Tim's mom saw that he was sad and asked him what was wrong. Tim told her about his lost wagon. His mom said they would go back to the park and look for it.

When they got to the park, Tim saw a man with a sack. The man had found Tim's wagon and put it in the sack to keep it safe. Tim was happy to have his wagon back and thanked the man. He put his wagon in the back of the car and they went home.

Once upon a time there was a garden. It was smelly and had lots of yucky stuff in it.

One day a boy came to the garden and he had a bucket of water. He started to pour the water into the garden. The water spread all around, making it look clean and shiny.

The boy kept pouring the water and soon all the smelly things in the garden were gone. After he finished pouring the water, he looked at the garden and it was beautiful! The flowers were bright and colorful and the grass was smooth and green.

The boy was so happy with the garden that he decided to play in it every day. He would run around, laugh and have lots of fun.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little car named Zoom. Zoom loved to drive really fast and explore new places. One day, Zoom got very tired and needed to sleep.

Zoom drove around looking for a cozy spot to sleep. Finally, Zoom found a nice soft patch of grass and parked there. Zoom closed his eyes and fell asleep.

While Zoom was sleeping, some other cars came by and saw him. They thought Zoom was very brave for driving so fast and exploring new places. They decided to leave a note for Zoom telling him how brave he was. When Zoom woke up, he was very happy to read the note and felt even braver than before.

Once upon a time, there lived two boys who were best friends. They always played together and had so much fun.

One day, the boys went outside to play and they decided to explore a cave. When they went inside, they saw a bright spirit. It was buzzing with energy and looked very special.

The boys were very curious and wanted to touch it, but the spirit said to them, "You must not touch me! I am too important and must stay here."

The boys were disappointed, but they said, "Ok, we understand. We will not touch you."

But then one of the boys had an idea. He suggested that if they asked nicely, the spirit would allow them to touch it. The other boy thought this was a great idea and so they asked the spirit nicely if they could touch it.

The spirit allowed them to touch it and the boys felt a great joy that they had never felt before. The spirit was so important that it made them feel special. They thanked the spirit and continued to explore the cave. From that day on, they would often come back to the cave and talk to the spirit.

One day, a young, adorable cat named Kitty went outside to play. She saw her friend, Doggy, who was playing with a big stick. Kitty wanted to play with the stick too, but Doggy didn't want to share. Kitty felt sad and walked away.

Kitty went to the park and saw a big tree. She had an idea! She would spread a nice picnic for her and Doggy. She hoped that if she shared her food, Doggy would share the stick. Kitty ran home to get food and a big, soft blanket.

Kitty spread the blanket under the tree and put yummy food on it. She went to find Doggy and asked him to come to the picnic. Doggy saw the food and felt happy. They ate and played together. Doggy learned to share the stick, and they both had a fun day at the park.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She was three years old and so curious about the world. One day Jane wanted to learn about the tiny things all around her, so she asked her mom to get her a microscope.

When the microscope arrived, Jane was so excited and ran to her room to look through it. But when she turned it on, loud noises and flashing lights came out of it. Jane panicked and didn't know what to do.

Luckily, Jane's mom heard the loud noises and came to her rescue. She quickly turned off the microscope and explained how to use it safely and correctly. Jane was happy because now she could learn about all the tiny things in the world.

The next day Jane used her microscope and was amazed by what she saw. She felt so lucky to have her mom who helped her when she panicked and taught her how to use the microscope.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy boats in the bathtub. One day, his mommy bought him a new boat. It was a big boat that looked like a yacht. Timmy thought it was very cool.

But then, Timmy accidentally dropped the boat and it broke. He was sad. His mommy said she would buy him a new one, but it was very expensive. Timmy waited and waited for his new boat to come.

Finally, the new boat arrived. Timmy was so excited. He carefully held it and played with it in the bathtub. When it was time to go to bed, Timmy didn't want to let go of his new boat. But he knew he had to release it and go to sleep. He went to bed happy, dreaming of sailing on his new yacht.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in her backyard with her toys. One day, she saw an unusual bird with bright feathers. It was so pretty! The bird blinked at her and Lily blinked back.

Lily wanted to win the bird's friendship, so she offered it some bread. The bird ate the bread and hopped closer to Lily. They became friends and played together every day.

One day, Lily's parents took her on a trip to the beach. She brought her new bird friend with her. They played in the sand and splashed in the water. When it was time to go home, Lily was sad. But the bird promised to visit her in her backyard again soon. And Lily knew that she had already won the best prize - a new friend.

Tom is a musician. He likes to play his guitar and sing songs. He has a gray hat and a gray coat. He goes to the park every day and plays his guitar for the people. Some people give him money and some people give him smiles.

One day, a man comes to the park. He has a big car and a big smile. He says to Tom, "Hello, musician. I like your songs. Do you want to sell me your guitar? I will give you a lot of money."

Tom thinks for a moment. He likes his guitar. It is his friend. He says to the man, "No, thank you. I do not want to sell my guitar. It is not for sale."

The man says, "But think of all the things you can buy with the money. You can buy a new hat, a new coat, a new guitar, anything you want."

Tom shakes his head. He says, "I do not need those things. I have everything I need. I have my guitar, my songs, and my friends in the park. They make me happy. Money does not make me happy."

The man frowns. He says, "You are a silly musician. You are missing a great opportunity. You will regret it." He gets in his car and drives away.

Tom does not care. He puts on his gray hat and his gray coat. He picks up his guitar and sings a song. He is happy. He is a musician.

Bob was feeling excited one day and so he decided that he wanted to go and explore. He picked up his hat and bag and asked his Mom if he could go out.

"Where do you want to go, Bob?" his Mom asked.

"I want to carry and explore underground," said Bob with a twinkle in his eye.

"Good idea," his Mom said.

So Bob went and he explored. He carried his bag as he looked and marveled at the underground world. He was having such a good time and didn't want to leave.

But when Bob finally did emerge from the underground, he was met with a very pleasant surprise. A bubble-blowing dog! It bounced around, bubbles streaming out of its mouth, making popping noises as they burst. The dog was so happy to see Bob and ran right up to him and started licking him.

Bob couldn't believe it! His underground adventure had led him to a good surprise. And he knew that he would have to carry this memory with him wherever he went.

Once upon a time, there was a happy dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball all day long. One day, Max's owner gave him a big meal. Max ate all his food and felt very full. After his meal, Max went outside to play. He ran in the grass and felt very playful. Suddenly, Max saw a butterfly and tried to catch it. He jumped up high and then he sprang into the air. Max had so much fun playing outside! The end.

One day, a boy named Tim went on a trip with his mom and dad. They went to a big park to observe animals. Tim saw a big, dry tree. He liked the tree very much.

Tim heard a bird in the tree. The bird said, "Hello, Tim!" Tim was very happy. He said, "Hello, bird! I like your tree. It is big and dry."

The bird said, "Thank you, Tim. I like my tree too. Do you want to be my friend?" Tim said, "Yes, I want to be your friend." They played and had fun. Tim and the bird were very happy on their trip.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her yellow ball. One day, she went to the store with her mommy. Her mommy told her to pick out a toy, but Lily saw a big bag of apples. She asked her mommy, "Can I get apples instead?" Her mommy said, "Sure, but let's check the price first."

Lily looked at the price and said, "It's too much!" Her mommy said, "We can still get some, just not the whole bag." As they were walking home, Lily took a bite out of an apple. She said, "Mmm, it's yummy!"

When they got home, Lily shared her apple with her little brother. He took a bite too and said, "It's sour!" Lily laughed and said, "That's okay, I still love it."

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park. She saw a big circle on the ground. It was not a normal circle. It was a magic circle. Lucy was very happy.

Lucy asked a boy named Tom, "Do you want to play with me?" Tom nodded and said, "Yes, I want to play with you and the magic circle." They both stood in the circle and started to spin around.

As they spun, the magic circle made them feel very light. They laughed and played together. After a while, they stopped spinning and the magic circle disappeared. Lucy and Tom smiled at each other, happy to have shared a fun day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, they decided to have a race to see who could run the fastest. Lily tried her best and she won the race! She was so happy and proud of herself.

After the race, they sat down on the grass and looked up at the sky. Lily observed the clouds and saw shapes like a bunny and a flower. Her friends saw different things too. They all giggled and had fun together.

Suddenly, the wind picked up and it started to get a little chilly. But it was only a mild breeze, so they decided to keep playing. They played on the swings and the slide until it was time to go home. Lily went home with a smile on her face, feeling happy about her win and the fun day she had with her friends.

Once upon a time, there were two parents who were very happy. One day, they wanted to surprise their little one, so they put on their shoes and drove in the car.

The little one saw the car and was so excited. She ran straight to it, hopped in and off they went!

They drove for a while until they arrived at a happy and safe place with lots of wonderful things. The little one was so amazed, she couldn't believe her eyes!

The parents showed her around and she saw lots of fun activities. She was so happy and thanked her parents for the surprise.

The little one had a wonderful time and was glad to be spending quality time with her parents. The feeling of being safe and loved was the best surprise ever.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his blocks. He would stack them up high and knock them down with a big smile on his face.

One day, Timmy's mom poured him a glass of milk. Timmy watched as the white liquid poured into the glass. He was amazed by how it looked.

After finishing his milk, Timmy went back to playing with his blocks. He built a tall tower and was so proud of himself. But then, he accidentally knocked it over. Timmy felt sad, but his mom reminded him that he could always build it again.

And so, Timmy started stacking his blocks again, feeling jolly once more. He knew that even if he knocked them down again, he could always pour them out and start over.

One day, a cat named Tom went to the store. He had a long list of things to buy. On the list, he had to buy milk. Tom walked a long way to the store.

At the store, Tom met a dog named Max. Max was looking at the milk too. Tom said, "Hi, Max! I need to add milk to my cart." Max said, "Me too, Tom! Let's get milk together."

Tom and Max got the milk and put it in their carts. They were happy to have milk for their homes. They walked the long way back together, talking and laughing. Tom and Max became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her garden. One day, while she was playing, she found a hidden dinosaur toy.

Lily was very happy to find the dinosaur. She played with it for a long time, pretending it was real and roaring like a big, scary monster. Suddenly, her mom called her for lunch.

Lily paused her game and ran inside. "Mom, look what I found!" she said, showing her mom the dinosaur toy. "Wow, that's really cool," her mom said. "Where did you find it?"

"It was hidden in the dirt," Lily said. "Can I bring it to the table with me?" "Sure, why not," her mom replied. Lily was so happy to have found the dinosaur and couldn't wait to play with it again after lunch.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a big truck that he loved to play with. One day, Timmy wanted to load his truck with lots of toys to take to his friend's house.

But when Timmy went to get his toys, he saw that his sister had taken his favorite toy car. Timmy was very sad because he wanted to take that car to his friend's house. He looked at his sister with a bad eye and said, "That's not fair!"

Timmy's sister saw that he was upset and gave him back his toy car. Timmy was happy again and loaded his truck with all of his toys. He went to his friend's house and they had lots of fun playing together. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big parade in town. Everyone was excited to see it. The parade was very popular, and lots of people came to watch.

A little girl named Lily was there with her family. She was so happy to see all the colorful floats and balloons. Suddenly, she saw a clown walking by. He looked very funny with his big red nose and silly hat.

Lily wanted to say hello to the clown, but she was too shy to speak. So, she just smiled and waved. The clown noticed her and came over to say hello. He gave her a balloon animal and they became friends.

After the parade, Lily was sad to say goodbye to her new friend. But the clown promised to come back next year for the parade. Lily was so excited to see him again and couldn't wait to speak to him. And just like the clown promised, he came back the next year and they had even more fun together.

Sara and Tom were playing with blocks in the living room. They liked to build towers and knock them down. Sara was very good at stacking the blocks high and straight. Tom was not so good. He often made his towers crooked and wobbly.

"Look at my tower, Tom!" Sara said. "It is taller than you!"

Tom looked at Sara's tower and felt angry. He wanted to have a tall tower too. He tried to grab some of Sara's blocks, but she pushed him away.

"Stop it, Tom! These are my blocks!" Sara said. "You have your own blocks!"

Tom did not listen. He reached for Sara's tower again, but this time he knocked it over. The blocks fell on the floor with a loud crash. Sara screamed and started to cry.

"Tom, you are so mean!" Sara said. "You ruined my tower!"

Tom felt bad, but he also felt embarrassed. He did not want Sara to cry. He did not want his mom to hear. He tried to say sorry, but he could not find the words. He ran to the couch and hid behind a pillow. He sucked his thumb and hoped nothing else would happen.

Once upon a time there was a big jar. It was filled with water and the grownups called it a hose. Every day, the kids had fun spraying water from the jar. They ran around, singing and laughing.

One day, the jar got a big hole in it. Water started spilling out of the jar and the kids stopped playing. They watched sadly as all the water drained away.

Suddenly, the grownups came to the rescue. They brought a replacement jar, only this one was even bigger! The kids gasped in amazement and quickly ran to get their toys. They began to laugh and play again and they had so much fun with the new jar.

The kids now loved to spray water even more. It was so much fun to watch the water fly out of the big jar. They knew the grownups had taken care of them and they thanked them with big hugs.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to play with bubbles. One sunny day, she went outside to blow some bubbles with her bubble wand.

Sue blew a big, graceful bubble. The bubble floated up into the sky. Sue wanted to see where the bubble would go, so she decided to follow it. She ran and skipped as the bubble danced in the wind.

The bubble led Sue to a beautiful park with lots of flowers. Sue felt happy and laughed as she played with the bubble. She knew that she would remember this special day forever.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was three years old and she loved helping her mom around the house. Every day, her mom would give her something to do like cleaning up her toys or making her bed. The little girl worked very hard. She was always busy!

One day, she was helping her mom when she saw something amazing. Her mom had made her a special surprise-a pink cupcake with sprinkles! She was so happy she gave her mom a big hug and thanked her for the treat.

The little girl never forgot that special day. Whenever she felt tired from doing her work, she thought back to that moment and it made her smile. She was very thankful for all the things her mom did for her.

The end.

Once there was a little girl who liked to make things. One day she saw a shelf on the floor and she wanted to make it clean.

She asked her mom if she could clean it and her mom said yes.

The little girl started to move things around to make it clean. She moved the books, toys and clothes from the shelf and put them into boxes.

When she was done, the shelf was nice and clean.

The little girl smiled and said, "Look at my shelf! Now it's clean!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Martha. Martha was very frightened. She was alone in the dark room, and the door had been locked shut.

The room was wide and cold. Martha heard a loud sound outside and she started to cry.

Suddenly she heard her father's voice. He called, "Martha! Where are you?"

She replied, "I'm here, Daddy, in the wide room, but the door is locked!"

Her father laughed and said, "Don't worry, I'm here now."

He opened the door, and when Martha saw him, she smiled.

Martha was no longer frightened, and the two hugged and went home.

One day, Daisy was feeling lonely. She didn't have anyone to play with, but she looked at the sky and saw a wonderful sunrise. Suddenly, a magical sparkle flew from the sky and landed in front of her. It was a sparkle fairy!

The sparkle fairy said she was lost and needed help. Daisy said she would rescue her. Daisy used her hand to carefully pick up the sparkle fairy and took her to a safe place.

The sparkle fairy thanked Daisy with a happy smile and flew away. Daisy waved goodbye and watched until the sparkle fairy had disappeared into the sky.

As Daisy looked back at the beautiful sunrise, she felt proud of herself for rescuing the sparkle fairy. She knew that she had made a difference and hadn't been so lonely after all.

Tom and Lily liked to go to the museum with Mom and Dad. They saw many things at the museum. They saw big bones of animals that lived long ago. They saw shiny rocks and colorful paintings. They saw a big train that made loud noises.

One day, they went to a new part of the museum. It was about food from different places. They saw pictures and models of food. They smelled different smells. Some smelled good, some smelled bad. They saw a sign that said "Try some spicy food". Tom and Lily were curious.

They asked Mom and Dad if they could try some spicy food. Mom and Dad said yes, but they warned them that spicy food might be too hot for them. They said they should only take a little bit and drink some water. Tom and Lily said please and thank you. They took a small piece of bread with red sauce on it. They put it in their mouths.

Tom and Lily felt a fire in their mouths. They felt their tongues and lips burn. They felt their eyes water. They felt their noses run. They spit out the bread and cried. Mom and Dad gave them some water and hugged them. They said they were sorry and that spicy food was not for everyone.

Tom and Lily learned that spicy food was not for them. They decided to stick to their favorite food, cheese and crackers. They still liked to go to the museum, but they never tried spicy food again.

Once there was a little girl named Lisa. Lisa loved juice more than anything. She thought it was the perfect drink for her. Every day, she would have juice with her breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

One sunny day, Lisa and her friends decided to play outside. They ran, jumped, and laughed together. After playing for a long time, they became very thirsty. Lisa thought it would be a good idea to discuss what kind of juice they should have to quench their thirst.

Lisa and her friends talked about their favorite juices. Some liked apple juice, others wanted orange juice, and a few preferred grape juice. They all agreed that juice was the perfect drink to have after playing outside. So, they went inside and enjoyed their favorite juices together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a gray cat named Mittens. One day, Lily and Mittens went to a party. It was a contest to see who could decorate the best cake.

Lily said to Mittens, "I hope we win the contest. I want to decorate a cake with lots of frosting and sprinkles." Mittens meowed in agreement.

Lily and Mittens worked hard to decorate their cake. They put frosting all over it and sprinkled it with colorful candy. When the judges tasted their cake, they said, "You win the contest! Your cake is the best!"

Lily and Mittens were so happy that they won. They celebrated by eating lots of cake and sharing it with their friends. From that day on, Lily and Mittens always loved to decorate cakes together.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved the color orange and had a big orange ball that she played with every day. One day, while playing with her ball, it went into the street and a car almost hit it.

Lily's mom told her, "You need to mind where you play with your ball, or else you could get hurt."

Later that day, Lily saw some police officers walking down the street. She asked her mom, "What are the police doing?"

Her mom replied, "The police are here to help keep us safe."

Lily thought about what her mom said and decided to be more careful when playing with her ball. She also felt happy knowing that the police were around to keep her and her family safe.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He had a new uniform for school. Tim was very happy to wear it. He loved how it looked on him.

One day, Tim's mom washed his uniform. But, she made a mistake. She used hot water. The uniform started to shrink. It became very small. Tim was sad. He could not wear it anymore.

Tim's mom said sorry. She took him to the store. They bought a new uniform. This one was loud and colorful. Tim liked it even more. He was happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a turkey. The turkey was walking slow in the farm. Suddenly, a boy came and wanted to play with the turkey. The boy chased the turkey and the turkey got scared. The turkey tried to fly away but it couldn't.

Then, the boy caught the turkey and held it tight. The turkey didn't like it and tried to break free. But the boy was too strong. The turkey got tired and stopped moving. The boy thought the turkey was sleeping, but it was not. The turkey was gone forever. The boy felt sad and didn't know what to do.

Once upon a time, there was a little ant named Tim. Tim was very organized. He liked to keep his ant hill clean and tidy. One day, Tim found a big bag of sugar. He was very happy and wanted to share it with his ant friends.

Tim went to his friend, Sam, and said, "Look, I found sugar! Let's share it with our friends!" Sam was excited and they both started to carry the sugar back to their ant hill. But on their way, they saw a big bird. They began to panic.

Tim and Sam quickly hid the sugar under a leaf and ran back to their ant hill. They told their friends about the bird and the sugar. All the ants worked together to make a plan. They decided to go back to the sugar, but this time they would be careful and watch out for the bird.

They all went back to the sugar and started to carry it back to their ant hill. They were very organized and worked together as a team. They watched out for the bird, but it never came back.

In the end, Tim, Sam, and their friends brought the sugar back to their ant hill. They were very happy and enjoyed eating the sweet sugar together. And they learned that even when they panic, they can still find a way to work together and be organized.

Once upon a time there were two worms called Sarah and Steve. Sarah and Steve loved their home, a warm and wet flowerpot. One day, a storm knocked over the flowerpot. Sarah and Steve were scared, so they decided to unite and look for a new home.

They searched and searched until they finally found a nice red rock. Sarah and Steve were so excited! However, they knew that this new rock wouldn't be very stable, so they had to be careful. Sarah said to Steve, "Let's dig a deep hole so that this rock won't fall over." Steve agreed and the two worms started digging.

After hours of digging, the two worms had created the perfect, new home. The red rock was secure and they were now safe from the storm.

Sarah and Steve smiled at each other, happy that they had united to create such a wonderful new home.

The End

Once upon a time, there was a fish named Finn. Finn lived in a big blue ocean with his friends. One day, Finn and his friends wanted to see the view from the top of the ocean. They swam and swam until they reached the top.

But when they got there, they saw a big, tight net. They tried to swim away, but they were stuck. They were scared and didn't know what to do. Then, they saw a friendly dolphin swimming by.

The dolphin saw that Finn and his friends were stuck and helped them get out of the net. Finn and his friends were so happy and grateful. They swam back to their home in the ocean, feeling safe and free once again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was very small and pale. One day, her father said to her, "Let's go on an adventure!" So, they set out on their adventure.

When they arrived at their destination, there was a wet, muddy puddle. Lucy wanted to go in it, but her Dad said, "No, Lucy. It's too wet and dangerous!". She pouted, but needed her Dad's support. Fortunately, her Dad smiled and said, "Perhaps we can cross over the puddle".

So, Lucy held her Daddy's hand and together they safely crossed the wet puddle. On the other side, was a beautiful garden! Lucy was so happy! She ran around the garden, enjoying all the different flowers, butterflies and birds.

Lucy and her Dad played together in the garden until the sun started to go down. Then, they went home, feeling very happy they had experienced such an adventure together. They could not wait until the next time they could have another adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a rabbit named Benny. Benny was very generous and loved to share his carrots with his friends.

One day, Benny went to the river to drink some water. While he was there, he accidentally fell in the water and got all wet. He wanted to go home but he didn't want to be wet. So, he asked his friend, a little bird, "Can you help me dry off?"

The little bird replied, "Sure, I can help you dry off. Let me flap my wings and make you dry." The little bird flapped his wings and Benny became dry. Benny was very happy and thanked his friend for being so helpful. From that day on, Benny and the little bird were the best of friends.

Once upon a time there was a car, and the car was broken! The car's owner went to find a mechanic. When the mechanic arrived, it was unusual - he was very small!

The mechanic explained what was wrong with the car; he said it needed a new part. He said the part was hard to find, but he was confident he could get it.

The mechanic went away and worked hard to find the part. When he returned, he fixed the car with the special part. The car was happy and ran perfectly again!

The mechanic was very pleased with himself. He explained to the car's owner how he had fixed the car. The car's owner thanked the mechanic, and they all went home. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited because she was going to have a sleepover with her friend, Emma. Lily's mommy helped her lay out a sheet on the floor for them to sleep on. They had pillows and blankets too.

Lily and Emma stayed up late telling stories and giggling. They were having so much fun! When it was time to go to sleep, they snuggled under the blankets and closed their eyes.

The next morning, Lily's mommy came in and saw that they had slept on the sheet. She was happy that they had such a good time together. Lily and Emma were already awake and ready for breakfast. They couldn't wait to have pancakes and syrup!

Sara and Ben are friends. They like to play with blocks. They have many blocks of different colors and shapes. They can make houses, towers, cars and animals with their blocks.

One day, Sara has a new block. It is a cute block. It has a face and a tail. It is a cat block. Sara loves cats. She shows her block to Ben.

"Look, Ben! I have a cat block. It is cute and soft. Do you want to play with it?" Sara asks.

Ben looks at the cat block. He likes it too. He wants to play with it. But he does not know how to make a cat sound. He only knows how to make a dog sound.

"I want to play with it, Sara. But I do not know how to say meow. I only know how to say woof. Can you teach me how to say meow?" Ben asks.

Sara smiles. She is happy to teach Ben how to say meow. She is good at making cat sounds. She holds the cat block and makes a meow sound.

"Meow, meow, meow. This is how you say meow, Ben. Try it with me. Meow, meow, meow." Sara says.

Ben listens to Sara. He tries to make a meow sound. He holds the cat block and says meow.

"Meow, meow, meow. I did it, Sara. I can say meow. Thank you for teaching me how to say meow." Ben says.

Sara and Ben hug. They are happy. They can play with the cat block and make meow sounds. They can also play with the other blocks and make other sounds. They have fun with their blocks. They are good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a bracelet that was very special. Her mom told her, "Lucy, when you wear this bracelet, you will feel powerful."

One day, Lucy and her friend Tim went to play in the park. They saw a big ball stuck in a tree. Tim said, "I wish we could get the ball down." Lucy smiled and said, "I can do it!" She put on her bracelet and felt powerful.

Lucy climbed the tree and got the ball down. Tim was so happy. He said, "Wow, Lucy! You are so strong!" Lucy smiled and said, "It's my special bracelet. It makes me feel powerful." They played with the ball all day and had lots of fun.

Once there was a baby. His name was Sam. He wanted to pick lots of flowers from the garden. His Mom allowed him to, but said he had to be gentle. Mom said the flowers were fragile.

So, ever so carefully, Sam started to pick the prettiest flowers he could find. He found roses, daisies, and lilies. He held them very gently, so he wouldn't hurt them. He put them all in his special basket.

When the basket was full, Sam ran off to show his Mom the flowers. His Mom was so proud of him, she said he was so gentle with the flowers.

Sam smiled and was so happy he got to pick the flowers. He went back to the garden to pick more and more flowers for his basket.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was enthusiastic. Everywhere she went she showed her excitement. She wanted to learn more and more each day.

One day she heard her parents talking about a wise old man who was said to have amazing wisdom. The little girl wanted to meet him, so she asked her parents if she could. They said yes, and the little girl set off happily.

When she arrived, the old man was busy, but the little girl was so enthusiastic that he stopped to talk to her. She asked him many questions and the old man answered them with his kind smiles and wise advice.

The little girl was so delighted that she took a moment to close her eyes and mind the conversation. She thought about all the wisdom she'd learnt, and smiled inside with joy. She had learned so much from the old man and couldn't wait to tell her parents all about it when she got home.

Bob had a new bag. He was very proud of it. It was big and reliable.

Bob wanted to use the bag to carry his toys to school. So, every day he put his toys into the bag.

At school, Bob would take out his toys and play with them. When he was done playing, he put them back into the bag.

The bag was reliable. It never lost any of Bob's toys. At the end of the day he would use the bag to carry his toys home.

Bob enjoyed using the bag because it was so reliable. He trusted it to keep his special toys safely with him.

One day, a beautiful boy named Tim went to the park. His mum told him to stay where she could see him. Tim found a nice grassy area, so he started to skip. He was very happy and smiled while he skipped.

After a while, Tim noticed a big billboard. It was very colourful, and he thought it was very beautiful. He wanted to go and have a closer look.

He ran over to the billboard, but then he remembered that his mum had told him to stay. He felt very sad, but he knew it was the right thing to do. He skipped back to the grassy area, and stayed where he was supposed to.

Tim smiled when he saw his mum looking over at him. He was very proud that he had remembered to stay.

Once upon a time, there was a big park with lots of trees and grass. Many kids liked to play there because it was so fun. One day, a little girl named Lily went to the park with her mommy.

Lily saw a big slide and wanted to go down it, but there were too many kids waiting. So, she decided to go on the swings instead. She stood on the ground and waited for her turn.

After a while, Lily got tired and wanted to go home. She asked her mommy where the exit was. Her mommy pointed to a gate and they walked towards it. On the way, they saw a popular ice cream truck. Lily wanted some ice cream, but her mommy said they could get some another time.

Finally, they reached the exit and went home. Lily was happy because she had fun at the park and knew she could come back another day.

Once upon a time, there was a little car named Red. Red liked to go fast and zoom around. One day, Red's engine started to make a funny noise. Red felt anxious because he didn't want to stop going.

Red's owner, Tim, took him to the mechanic. The mechanic checked under Red's hood and found that he needed some oil. The mechanic put some oil in Red's engine and he felt much better.

Red was happy to go fast again and Tim was happy that Red was fixed. They went on a fun adventure together and Red didn't have to worry about his engine anymore. The end.

John was a little boy. He had two shoes and wore them everywhere. One day he was walking outside when he saw a pigeon. The pigeon was big and fluffy with a grey and white pattern in its feathers.

John said, "Hello little pigeon."

The pigeon cooed at him and hopped on the ground. It was a bit rough and John thought the pigeon might be lost. He looked around at all the buildings to see if there was anywhere for the pigeon to go.

John said, "Do you need help? I can help you if you'd like."

The pigeon cooed again and then started walking. John followed to see what the pigeon wanted. Suddenly, the pigeon hopped up on a big building with a pond in the middle.

John said, "Oh, that looks perfect. Have a nice home, little pigeon."

The pigeon cooed one last time and flew away. John smiled and clapped his hands in excitement. He was glad he could help the pigeon find a new home.

Once upon a time, there were two friends called Amy and Ben.

Amy was a little girl and was three years old. Ben was an orange crane.

One day, Amy and Ben decided to go on an adventure.

So they started to march towards the forest. The sun was shining and they were happy.

Suddenly, it started to rain. Amy and Ben were getting wet!

They stopped and looked around.

Amy said to Ben: "What do we do now?".

Ben replied, "Let's march a bit further. I think I can see a dry spot over there."

And so Amy and Ben marched again. The rain finally stopped and they eventually made it to the dry spot.

Amy and Ben had lots of fun and enjoyed their adventure. They were happy to have made it to the dry spot!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny. The bunny was playing in his garden when he heard something loud. It was a surprise! He saw a big dog running towards him. The bunny was scared, so he ran away.

He ran and he ran until he found a big bush. He quickly ran and hid inside. The big dog couldn't find him! He had escaped!

The bunny was so happy he hopped out the bush. He was safe now and he could play again.

The end.

Once there was a bald man who lived in a big house. He looked out his window each day and saw the waste that was all around. There was lots of rubbish and things that he wanted to throw away.

So the bald man decided he wanted to do something about the waste. He came up with a plan to tidy it all up.

He gathered lots of friends together from all around the world and asked everyone to help. Some swept up the rubbish, some put it in bags and some recycled the things that could be reused.
