After hours and hours of hard work, they had finished cleaning up and they all looked around to see the amazing job they'd done. Everyone was excited - they had turned the waste into something beautiful and the bald man was so proud. Everyone clapped and applauded their hard work.

Tom and Sue were hungry. They wanted to eat meat for dinner. But they had no meat at home. They had to go to the shop.

"Let's go to the shop and buy some meat," Tom said to Sue.

"OK, but we have to be alert. There are big dogs on the way. They might chase us and bite us," Sue said to Tom.

They put on their shoes and coats and went out. They walked fast and looked around. They saw some big dogs on the other side of the street. They did not mention them. They did not want to make them angry.

They reached the shop and went inside. They saw a lot of meat on the shelves. They picked one that looked good and juicy. They paid the man and put the meat in a bag.

They were happy. They had meat for dinner. They walked back to their home. They did not see the big dogs. They thought they were safe.

But they were wrong. The big dogs smelled the meat. They followed them quietly. They waited for the right moment to attack.

When Tom and Sue were near their home, they heard a loud bark. They turned around and saw the big dogs running towards them. They were scared. They dropped the bag and ran to their door. They opened it and went inside. They slammed the door and locked it.

The big dogs reached the bag and tore it open. They ate the meat. They were happy. They had meat for dinner.

Tom and Sue looked out the window and saw the big dogs. They were sad. They had no meat for dinner. They wished they had mentioned the big dogs to the man at the shop. Maybe he would have given them a better bag. Or maybe he would have warned them to take a different way. Or maybe he would have helped them to scare the big dogs away.

They learned a lesson. They should always be alert and mention the big dogs. They should not take risks for meat. They should be careful and smart. They hoped they would find some more meat tomorrow. They hoped the big dogs would not find them again.

Once there was a little girl named Susie. She was playing with her toys in the garden. Susie had a special box with a map inside. The map was very colourful and had lots of interesting shapes.

One day Susie's mother saw her playing and said, "Susie, why don't you finish the map?" Susie looked at the map and said, "It's too heavy, I can't do it!"

Susie's mother smiled and said, "No big job is too hard, but only if you work together. If you work together, you can finish anything."

So Susie asked a few friends to help, and they worked together to finish the map. They had a lot of fun. They laughed, sang and worked until the map was completed.

The moral of this story is that working together makes hard things easier. We can all work together to achieve great things!

Once there was a monkey who lived in a very tall tree. He was very uncomfortable living there. To make it better, he decided to set up a banana stand.

The monkey worked hard to get his stand ready. He chose the perfect spot and set up his stand so that everyone could see it from a distance. Then he hung a sign with a big banana on it.

The next morning, many animals came to the stand to buy bananas. Everyone wanted to buy the sweet and juicy bananas.

The monkey was so happy to see so many people buying his bananas. From then on, the monkey was never uncomfortable in that tree again. He was always busy making sure everyone had enough delicious bananas.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and jump on the steps of her porch. One day, her mommy came outside and said, "Lily, let's go to the park!" Lily was so excited and her smile increased even more.

At the park, Lily saw her friend Max. Max was sad because he lost his favorite toy. Lily said, "Don't worry Max, we can help you find it!" They looked all around the park and finally found Max's toy on a step by the slide. Max was so happy and his smile increased too.

After they found the toy, they all played together and had so much fun. Lily's mommy said it was time to go home, but Lily and Max wanted to stay and play more. Lily's mommy said, "Okay, we can stay for five more minutes." Lily was so happy that they got to play a little longer. When it was time to go, Lily said goodbye to Max and her smile increased even more because she had such a fun day.

Once there was a dog named Spot. Spot was very fast and everyone envied him. He loved to stretch out and show off his speed.

One day, Spot was running so fast that he outran his own tail. He tried to catch it, but he just couldn't. Everyone laughed and cheered at Spot as he kept running and stretching trying to catch it.

Finally, Spot stopped and looked around. He noticed a cat sitting nearby, looking envious. Spot walked up to it and asked, "Do you want to race?" The cat's eyes lit up, and he agreed.

The race began and Spot stretched out and ran as fast as he could. The cat tried to keep up, but he just didn't have the same speed. Eventually, Spot reached the finish line first and cheered his victory.

Spot had learned to never underestimate a cat, but he was proud of his speed. He had definitely stretched his legs that day.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a daddy who had a little baby. The baby was very small and could not talk yet. One day, mommy and daddy started to quarrel about who would take care of the infant. The baby was scared and started to cry.

Suddenly, the baby stopped crying and looked very still. The mommy and daddy realized that the infant was not moving anymore. They were very sad because the baby was dead. They hugged each other and cried.

After a while, mommy and daddy talked to each other and said sorry for quarreling. They knew that they needed to work together to take care of the baby. They promised to always love and take care of each other and the new baby they would have one day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She loved to bake things in the kitchen with her mommy. Every week, Sarah and her mommy would bake something delicious like cupcakes or cookies.

One day, Sarah had a great idea. She wanted to bake something special for her mommy. She decided to bake her a special birthday cake.

As Sarah and her mommy baked the cake together, they each added something cute and special. Sarah added some adorable chocolate chips while her mommy added some rainbow sprinkles.

At last, the birthday cake was finished. Sarah's mommy loved it and said it was the most delicious cake ever made!

The moral of this story is that it's important to show your loved ones how much you care. Little things like baking a cake can make someone feel very special.

Once upon a time, there was a duck named Ducky. Ducky liked to row in the pond. One day, Ducky saw his friend Bunny driving a car. Bunny asked Ducky if he wanted to come for a ride. Ducky said yes and hopped in the car. Bunny drove the car around and they had a funny time. After the ride, Ducky went back to rowing in the pond, happy to have had a new adventure with his friend Bunny.

Once upon a time, there was a little island. On this island, there lived a bird named Bob. Bob loved to fly and sing all day. One day, Bob felt tired. He wanted to do something new.

Bob had an idea. He would record his songs. He thought that if he recorded his songs, other birds would hear them and sing with him. Bob was excited about his idea, but he did not know how to record.

Bob asked his friend, the wise old owl, for help. The owl told him that he needed a special box to record his songs. Bob searched the island, but he could not find the special box.

Bob became very sad. He flew back to his tree, still tired, and without his songs recorded. His dream of singing with other birds did not come true. And so, Bob's story had a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little mouse who lived in a house. The mouse loved to display all of its shiny things on a shelf. One day, a big cat came to the house and saw all the shiny things on the shelf. The cat wanted to take all the shiny things for itself.

The mouse was scared and tried to hide, but the cat found it. The cat chased the mouse all around the house. The mouse tried to escape, but the cat was too fast. In the end, the cat caught the mouse and took all of its shiny things.

The mouse was sad and had to start all over again. It learned that sometimes it's best to keep things hidden and safe from others who might want to take them away.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Daisy. Daisy was only 3 years old, but she was very wise.

One day, Daisy was feeling sad because she had forgotten something very important. She really wanted to remember, but she couldn't find the answer.

But then Daisy remembered something her mom had said: "Some truths are hard to understand, but remember to never give up". Daisy smiled and felt happy again.

The next day, Daisy decided to go for a walk in the park. She felt so peaceful, it seemed like all her worries had gone away. She started to notice all the beautiful things around her--the trees, the birds, the sunshine.

But then something odd caught her eye. It was an empty spot in the middle of the grass. Daisy wondered what could have been there before, but she soon realized that this empty spot held the truth she had been looking for all along.

Daisy smiled. She had finally remembered.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She had many pins. She wanted to do something special with them.

One day, she decided to make a scary monster out of her pins. She was very excited to do it. She got to work, carefully placing the pins together.

Soon enough, the scary monster was complete. She was so proud of her work. She ran to show her friends. They all cheered when they saw the scary monster.

The girl was so happy. She had done something wonderful with her pins. Her friends loved it too.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy was very healthy because he always ate his fruits and veggies. One day, Timmy went to the park to play with his friends.

Timmy's friend, Sarah, had a new toy car. "Look at my new car!" Sarah said. "It can zoom really fast!"

"Wow, that's cool!" said Timmy. "Can I try it?"

"Not yet," said Sarah. "I want to play with it for a little longer."

Timmy was sad that he couldn't play with the car yet, but he decided to play on the swings instead. As he swung back and forth, he saw a butterfly zoom past him. "Look, a butterfly!" he said.

Sarah came over and they watched the butterfly together. "It's so pretty," said Sarah.

"Yeah, and it can zoom really fast too!" said Timmy.

They continued to play at the park until it was time to go home. Timmy was happy that he had a fun day with his friends, even though he didn't get to play with the car yet.

Bobby was a proud little boy. He loved to play outdoors and explore the world around him. He would often find something new and exciting to do every day. One day, Bobby decided to catch a computer. So, he ran around the house looking for one. He finally found a computer in his mother's office.

He was so proud and excited as he carefully picked it up. He ran around the house, giggling and carrying it in his arms. He showed it to everyone and told them he had caught a computer. His family was amazed and proud of Bobby for such a feat.

For the rest of the day, Bobby decided to put the computer to good use and learn some new things. He watched videos, played some cute games, and read stories. He was so proud of himself for catching a computer.

The sun shone brightly in the sky and two best friends were playing in the park. One had a nice collar on, which made her look quite special compared to the other.

"I like your collar," said the first friend.

"Thank you. It's really nice!" replied the other.

"Do you want to wear it too?"

"Yes, I value that!" beamed the first friend and put the collar around her friend's neck.

The two friends kept playing, but the second one felt extra special with the nice collar. They were having so much fun!

The first friend saw that her friend was particularly happy and so she said "I value you so much!"

"I value you too!" replied the friend with the collar.

The two friends hugged each other tightly to seal their bond of true friendship. They both knew that no matter what, they would always value each other.

Lily and Max are playing in the park. They see a big green hill with many flowers. Lily likes the yellow flowers. Max likes the blue ones. They run to the hill and pick some flowers.

But then, Lily sees something else. She sees a small hole in the hill. She wonders what is inside. She goes closer and looks. She sees a furry nose and two black eyes. It is a rabbit!

Lily is happy. She loves rabbits. She wants to pet it. She reaches her hand to the hole. But the rabbit does not like that. It pokes Lily's hand with its teeth. Ouch! Lily cries. She pulls her hand back. It hurts.

Max hears Lily cry. He runs to her. He sees her hand. It has a red mark. He sees the hole. He sees the rabbit. He is angry. He wants to scare the rabbit. He picks up a stick. He pokes the hole with the stick. He makes a loud noise.

But the rabbit does not get scared. It gets mad. It jumps out of the hole. It pokes Max's leg with its claws. Ouch! Max cries. He drops the stick. He hugs his leg. It hurts.

Lily and Max are both sad. They are both hurt. They are both sorry. They leave the hole. They leave the hill. They leave the park. They go home. They tell their mom. She gives them a hug. She gives them a band-aid. She gives them a cookie. She tells them a lesson.

She says, "Do not poke animals. They do not like it. They can poke back. It is not nice. It is not fun. It is not safe. If you see an animal, be gentle. Be quiet. Be respectful. Or, leave it alone. That is the best way to play."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing with his toy cubes. He had a red cube, a blue cube, and a green cube. One day, Timmy's mommy said, "Timmy, it's time to go to bed. You look sleepy."

Timmy didn't want to go to bed yet. He wanted to play with his cubes some more. So, he acted like he was already asleep. "Goodnight, Timmy," said his mommy as she tucked him in.

After his mommy left the room, Timmy quietly got out of bed and played with his cubes. He stacked them up high and then knocked them down. Suddenly, he heard a noise. It was his mommy coming back to check on him.

Quickly, Timmy jumped back into bed and pretended to be asleep. His mommy smiled and said, "Good job, Timmy. You're such a good boy for going to sleep." Timmy smiled too, knowing he had tricked his mommy. From then on, he made sure to play with his cubes before bedtime so he wouldn't be too sleepy to play.

One day a little boy wanted to explore. He opened the door to the barn and peeked inside. He saw there were lots of creatures living in the barn. The little boy felt comfortable and curious, so he stepped inside.

He heard a noise and saw a horse. He was so excited and said, "Hello, horse! What is your name?"
The horse looked at him and said, "My name is Lucky."
The little boy was happy and said, "That's a cool name!"

Lucky smiled and said, "I have some friends. You should meet them!"
The little boy followed Lucky around the barn and met the other horses, cows, pigs, and chickens. They were all so friendly and comfortable.

The little boy said, "Thank you for showing me around. This is the best day ever!"

Lucky nodded and said, "It was my pleasure. Maybe we can explore the barn again soon!"

The little boy smiled and opened the door to leave. He knew he would never forget this wonderful day at the barn.

Once upon a time, there was a modern store. In the store, there were many toys and games. Kids loved to come and play there.

One day, a little mosquito came into the store. The mosquito saw all the toys and wanted to play too. He flew around, looking at everything.

The kids saw the mosquito and wanted to catch him. They chased him all around the store. But the mosquito was too fast. The kids laughed and had so much fun. In the end, the mosquito flew away, and the kids went back to play with the toys. Everyone was happy in the modern store.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear who loved to eat dessert. One day, he went to his mommy and asked for a soft cake. His mommy said, "Sure, my little bear. Let me pack a cake for you."

The little bear was very happy and took the soft cake with him. He went to the forest and sat under a tree. He ate his dessert and felt very full. Then, he saw a little bird who was sad. The bird said, "I lost my nest. I don't know where to go."

The little bear felt sorry for the bird and said, "Don't worry, I will help you." He packed some soft leaves and made a new nest for the bird. The bird was very happy and thanked the little bear. From that day on, they became good friends and ate dessert together under the tree.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to sail on his boat in the park's pond. He felt very happy when he was sailing.

One day, Timmy entered a sailing race. He wanted to win the big trophy. Timmy tried his best, but he didn't win. He felt sad.

After the race, Timmy decided to sail on his own. He wanted to be independent. But, suddenly, a big storm came. Timmy's boat flipped over, and he fell into the water. Timmy couldn't swim, and he drowned.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a fat arrow. Every day, the fat arrow would fly high in the sky. One day, the fat arrow wanted to fly even higher than it ever had before. It flew up and up, until it was so high it couldn't be seen. But the fat arrow kept going higher and higher. Eventually the fat arrow flew so high that it saw the stars and the moon in the night sky. The fat arrow was so happy to have seen the stars and the moon. From then on, it would fly up to the stars and the moon every night and look at them. The end.

Lily and Sam were at the park with their mum. They liked to play on the swings and the slide. They also liked to look at the sky and see the birds and the clouds.

"Look, Lily, an aeroplane!" Sam said, pointing up. "It is big and white and fast."

Lily looked up and saw the aeroplane too. She wondered where it was going and who was inside. She wanted to fly in an aeroplane someday.

"Can we go in an aeroplane, mum?" Lily asked.

Mum smiled and said, "Maybe one day, Lily. But aeroplanes are very expensive and far away. We have to save money and plan ahead."

Lily felt sad. She wanted to go in an aeroplane now. She thought it would be fun and exciting.

"Please, mum, please," Lily said. "Can we go in an aeroplane soon?"

Mum hugged Lily and said, "I know you want to go in an aeroplane, Lily, but we have to be patient and grateful for what we have. We have a nice home, good food, and each other. We can have fun here too."

Lily nodded. She knew mum was right. She loved her mum and Sam and their home. She still wanted to go in an aeroplane, but she decided to wait and hope. Maybe one day, she would see the world from the sky.

Once upon a time, there was a silly tiger named Tony. Tony liked to play tricks on his friends in the jungle. One day, Tony saw a monkey named Max walking by. Tony jumped out and scared Max. Max got very scared and ran away.

Later that day, Max saw Tony again. Max said, "Tony, why did you scare me earlier? That wasn't very nice." Tony said, "I'm sorry, Max. I was just playing around. Can we be friends again?" Max thought about it and said, "Okay, but no more scaring me!"

Tony and Max settled their disagreement and became friends again. From that day on, Tony stopped playing tricks on his friends in the jungle. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she saw a charming butterfly flying around her garden. It was so pretty, with its colorful wings.

Lily wanted to catch the butterfly, so she leaned over to try and catch it. But the butterfly flew away, up into the sky. Lily felt sad and looked down at the earth. She saw a little ant crawling around and decided to follow it.

The ant led her to a beautiful flower, where more butterflies were fluttering around. Lily felt happy again and sat down to watch them. She realized that sometimes, you just have to lean back and enjoy the beauty of the earth around you.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to explore. One day, she went on a walk with her mommy and daddy. They walked and walked until they came to a big, wide field.

Lily ran and played in the field, but then she saw something that made her sad. She saw a broken toy car that someone had left behind. Lily wanted to fix it so she could play with it, but she didn't know how.

Later that day, Lily's daddy showed her how to fix the toy car. He used a screwdriver and some glue to put it back together. Lily was so happy! She realized that anything can be fixed if you try hard enough.

As they walked back home, Lily looked up at the sky and saw all the stars in the universe. She felt like she could do anything now that she knew how to fix things. From that day on, Lily became the best fixer in town.

Lily and Ben are friends who like to play with their dogs. Lily has a big dog named Spot, and Ben has a small dog named Fluffy. One day, they go to the park with their dogs and see a new slide.

"Let's go on the slide with our dogs!" Lily says. "It will be fun!"

"No, no, no!" Ben says. "That is not a good idea. The slide is too high and too fast for our dogs. They might get hurt or scared."

Lily and Ben disagree. They both think they are right and the other is wrong. They start to argue and get angry.

Spot and Fluffy watch their friends fight. They do not like to see them unhappy. They are clever dogs. They have an idea. They run to the slide and climb up the steps. They wear their collars, which have tags with their names and phone numbers. They slide down together, one after the other. They bark and wag their tails. They have fun.

Lily and Ben see their dogs on the slide. They are surprised and worried. They run to the slide and catch their dogs. They hug them and check if they are okay. They are glad their dogs are safe and happy.

They look at each other and feel sorry. They realize they were silly to disagree and argue. They say sorry and make up. They learn to respect each other's opinions and feelings. They play together with their dogs on the slide and have fun. They are good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and have tea parties with her friends. One day, she was playing with her favorite cup when her brother came in.

"Hey Lily, what are you doing?" he asked.

"I'm having a tea party with my dolls," she replied.

Her brother looked at her fiercely and said, "I don't care about your silly tea parties."

Lily felt sad and started to cry. But then her mom came in and asked what was wrong.

"My brother doesn't care about my tea party," she said.

Her mom hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. I care about your tea parties and so do your dolls. Let's have a tea party together!"

Lily's face lit up with joy and she hugged her mom. They all sat down and had a wonderful tea party together with Lily's favorite cup.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Anna. She did not know what to do one day so she decided to go on an adventure. She went to stay in a fake house. It was made of cardboard and it was much too small for her to fit in.

Anna began to explore the fake house until she came to the door. But the door was stuck, so Anna started to pull and push to try and open it. Suddenly it swung open and Anna saw something she did not know existed - a secret garden! In the garden there were lots of flowers, buzzing bees and colourful butterflies. Anna was amazed at all of these things she did not know about before.

She stayed in the secret garden for a while, until the sun started to go down. Anna got a bit scared, so she ran back to her house and closed the door behind her.

She had had a wonderful adventure and she now knew about the secret garden. She was happy to have found it and now she knew how to get back there whenever she wanted to stay.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to go to the big mall with Mom. The mall has many shops and toys and people. The twins enjoy looking at everything.

But their favorite thing is the elevator. The elevator is a big box that moves up and down. It has buttons and lights and a door that opens and closes. The twins like to press the buttons and watch the lights. They like to feel the elevator go up and down.

One day, they go to the mall with Mom. They see the elevator and run to it. Mom follows them. They press the button and wait for the door to open.

"Can we go to the top floor, Mom?" Anna asks.

"Sure, sweetie. Let's go to the top floor and see the view," Mom says.

They get in the elevator and press the button for the top floor. The door closes and the elevator starts to move. The twins watch the lights change and count the floors.

"One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!" Ben says.

The elevator stops and the door opens. They see a big window that shows the whole city. The city is light and bright and colorful. The twins are amazed.

"Wow, look at that, Anna!" Ben says.

"Wow, look at that, Ben!" Anna says.

They run to the window and point at the buildings and cars and trees. Mom smiles and joins them. They enjoy the view and the elevator. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved winter. He loved to play in the snow and build snowmen. One day, he found a shiny rock that he thought was a treasure. He shouted, "It's mine!"

The little boy was so happy that he wanted to celebrate. He invited all his friends to come and play with him in the icy snow. They had lots of fun together and drank hot cocoa to warm up.

At the end of the day, the little boy went to bed with his treasure under his pillow. He dreamed of all the fun he would have with his friends the next day. He was so excited to celebrate his happiness with them again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big nose and loved to smell everything. Her mom always said she was nosy, but Lily didn't know what that meant.

One day, Lily's mom gave her a seed and said, "Plant this in the ground and watch it grow!" Lily was so excited and ran outside to find a spot to plant it. She rubbed the dirt with her hands and put the seed in the ground.

Every day, Lily watered the seed and waited for it to grow. One day, she saw a tiny sprout poking out of the ground! She was so happy and ran inside to tell her mom. "Mommy, mommy! The seed is growing!" she exclaimed.

Her mom smiled and said, "See, Lily? You have to be patient and let things grow." From that day on, Lily learned that sometimes it takes time for things to grow, but it's worth the wait.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a toy car that he loved to play with every day. One day, Timmy's mom told him that they were going to sell the car because they needed more money for food. Timmy was sad, but he understood that it was important.

After they sold the car, Timmy and his mom cleaned the house. They dusted the shelves and the tables. Timmy thought it was fun to watch the dust fly in the air.

Later that day, Timmy's dad came home with an impressive surprise. He had bought Timmy a new toy car! Timmy was so happy and he hugged his dad tight. He knew that they didn't have much money, but his dad still found a way to make him smile.

One day, two green birds were flying in the sky. They were looking for something special. Suddenly, the birds saw a cloud of oxygen. It was like a big, white bush.

The birds wanted to catch the oxygen, so they flew closer. With one big swoop, they caught the oxygen in their beaks.

The birds were so excited that they had caught the oxygen. It felt like they were flying on a breeze. So they flew back home with the oxygen in their beaks.

At home, the birds put the oxygen in a jar. It was like a green balloon in the jar.

Every day the birds looked at the oxygen in the jar and smiled. They were the only ones that had caught the special cloud of oxygen.

Once upon a time, there was a furry bear. His name was Jazz. He lived all alone in the forest.

One day, he saw a bird flying outside his cave. It had something in its beak. Jazz was curious, so he followed the bird to its nest.

In the nest, the bird had a present for Jazz. It was bring a big, juicy, red apple. Jazz was thankful for the kind gesture and thanked the bird.

The next day, Jazz was excitedly waiting for the bird. He wanted to give the bird something in return. When the bird came back, Jazz brought with him a basket of freshly picked berries. He was happy to give the bird a snack.

Jazz and the bird became friends and they used to spend lots of their time together. They laughed, sang, and danced to the sound of Jazz's music. They had lots of fun!

That's how the furry bear Jazz and the bird became friends. They shared their days, filled with love and laughter.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat yummy food like chocolate and ice cream. One day, her mom made a pastel that looked unusual. It was pink with purple spots! Lily was curious and asked her mom what it was. Her mom said it was a special kind of cake and asked if she wanted to try it. Lily nodded her head excitedly and took a big bite. It was the most delicious pastel she had ever eaten! From that day on, Lily asked her mom to make the unusual pastel every week.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy was three years old and she loved to play outside. Whenever she went outside, she felt the wind on her face. On this day, she noticed the wind was blowing something strange. Curious, she went closer and saw it was a balloon!

The balloon was bright red and had a yummy smell. Lucy couldn't wait to have it. She quickly grabbed it, then ran off to show her mom.

"Mom, look what I found!" Lucy said.

"Well, that's a very special balloon, isn't it? What do you think we should do with it?"

"Store it!" Lucy said right away.

So Lucy's mom put the balloon away in a safe place, and at night when it was time to go to bed, Lucy knew that her special balloon would still be there waiting for her.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Clara. She was three years old and loved to play outside.

One day Clara decided to go for a walk. As she walked she saw a lady in the park with a dog. The lady looked very worried. Clara smiled and said hello.

The lady smiled back and asked Clara what her name was. Clara told her as she patted the dog. The lady said she was very happy to meet Clara and was no longer worried.

Clara smiled and said bye to the lady. She then went home and had a very nice day!

Once upon a time, there was a sad leopard named Leo. Leo lived in the big jungle. He was sad because he had no friends to play with. One day, he saw a little bird named Blue.

"Hi, Blue," said Leo. "Will you come and play with me?"

"Okay!" said Blue. "Let's play together."

Leo and Blue played all day long. They played hide and seek, and catch the ball. They had so much fun. Soon, all the other animals in the jungle saw them playing. They wanted to play too. So, they all came and played together. Leo was not sad anymore. He was happy because he had many friends.

The moral of the story is: when you are kind and share, you will have many friends.

Once upon a time, there was a filthy way that was very yucky. All the animals stayed away because their feet would get all muddy. One day, a strange thing happened. The way started to shrink! It got smaller and smaller, until everyone could only see a tiny little road. All the animals were so happy! They all danced and cheered as they crossed over the little way. The way was so tiny that it never got dirty again. Everyone was so happy they had a clean way to walk on. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the sun all day long. He would run and jump and play with his friends until he was very tired.

One day, Timmy's mom asked him to clean up his toys before dinner. Timmy didn't want to stop playing, but he knew he had to listen to his mom. So he picked up all of his toys and put them away.

Later that night, Timmy's mom asked him why he was so tired. Timmy answered, "I played in the sun all day and then I cleaned up my toys." His mom smiled and said, "That's because you worked hard today. It's important to listen to me and do what I ask, even if you're tired. It shows that you're responsible and respectful."

From that day on, Timmy always listened to his mom and did what she asked. He learned that it's important to answer to your parents and be a good helper, even when you're tired.

Once there was a cute little girl called Emily. She loved to play in the park with her family. She loved to watch the birds and look at the flowers. Emily always saw the pretty herb garden when they visited the park. The colors were so adorable.

One day while they were visiting the park, Emily wanted to pick some herbs. Her dad helped her pick some and then she took them home. Emily was so happy. She put the herbs in her garden at home and every day she watched them grow.

With time, Emily's herb garden was beautiful and filled with lots of different flowers. She was so proud of it and visited the park every day to pick some more herbs. Every time she did, people would stop to admire her garden and tell her how adorable it was.

Once upon a time, there was a big, wild lion. He was very strong and had a big, fluffy mane. One day, he saw a white rabbit and chased after it. The rabbit ran as fast as it could, but the lion was too fast. The rabbit screamed for help, but no one came. Just when the lion was about to catch the rabbit, a kind girl appeared and scared the lion away. The rabbit was safe and happy.

Sara and Ben like to play with colors. They have many crayons and paints. They can make different pictures with them. One day, they want to make a picture of a big pink castle.

"How do we make pink?" Sara asks Ben.

"We mix red and white," Ben says. He shows Sara how to mix the paints with a brush. "See? It is pink now."

Sara nods. She dips her brush in the pink paint and starts to draw the castle. She makes a big door, some windows, and a flag. Ben helps her with the towers and the walls.

They are happy with their picture. They show it to their mom.

"Wow, what a beautiful castle!" Mom says. "Where is it?"

"It is in a distant land," Sara says. "Far, far away."

"Can we go there?" Ben asks.

"Maybe in your dreams," Mom says. She smiles and hugs them. "You are very creative and talented. I love your picture."

The dark night was full of stars and all was quiet. Suddenly, a bright bulb lit up the sky. The bulb was so big and so bright that it made everything seem so sunny. But then the bright bulb started to dim. It slowly faded until it vanished.

The darkness was back. But wait, something was happening. A new bulb lit up the night. This bulb was smaller and not as bright as the first one, but it still lit up the night.

The people watching the bulbs were getting tired. The small bulb faded slowly too, but it was still lighting the night for some time. Eventually, the bulb finally finished and the darkness returned once more.

The people were sad to see the bulb done, but looking up, they knew the stars were still there. Even in the darkest of nights, the stars continue to shine.

Once upon a time there was a sleepy boy named Thomas. One night, he took his flashlight and went outside to explore. He was so excited. He wanted to go on a great adventure.

Thomas walked in the dark and saw a pond. He spotted something shiny in the water. He thought it must be treasure!

Thomas yelled out, "What is it? What is it?"

His mom said, "It's a rock! You can't get it."

Thomas didn't want to give up. He said, "I'm going to dive in and get it."

His mom said, "No, it's too dark and too deep. You could get hurt."

But Thomas was brave. He put his flashlight in his pocket and jumped into the water. He grabbed the rock and held it tightly.

When he came out of the water, his mom said, "I'm so proud of you for being brave. Now let's go inside and celebrate your great adventure."

That night, Thomas went to sleep with a smile, happy that he had gone on a great dive with his flashlight.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. She was so happy because one day, her mommy invited her to go to the forest. Jane was so glad!

When they arrived, the forest was so magical. Everything was green and beautiful, and the sunshine lit up the trees. Jane felt like she was in a fairytale.

In the middle of the forest, Jane saw a big tree with colorful birds flying around it. All of a sudden, the birds started flying around Jane and singing a beautiful song. Jane couldn't believe it was real!

After that, Jane saw an old man with a long white beard. He smiled at Jane, and said he was a magical man. He said he could make things happen in a blink of an eye. Jane was so glad and amazed.

The magical old man asked Jane if she wanted to play a game. Jane happily nodded her head yes. He smiled and invited her to fly with him around the forest. So, Jane and the magical man flew above the trees and had so much fun.

When they were done, the magical old man waved goodbye and vanished. Jane came back home with a big smile on her face. She knew it was a magical day and she would never forget it!

Once upon a time there was a pretty bubble. This bubble was special because it was separated into two parts - the top part and the bottom part.

One day a three year old found the bubble. "Look how pretty it is!" they said.

The bubble was so pretty that the three year old decided to take it home. When they got home, they showed it to their friends.

The friends couldn't believe how pretty the bubble was! They asked the three year old how it was separated into two parts.

The three year old smiled and said, "It's so simple! I just twist it and it separates into the top part and the bottom part".

The friends were very impressed and wanted to try it out themselves. So they all grabbed bubbles and started twisting and separating them into two parts.

In the end, they all had their own pretty bubbles! And they all enjoyed the fun of separating bubbles!

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy train. The train had a big engine that went "Choo Choo!" Tim played with his train every day.

One day, Tim noticed that his train was not moving. He looked at the engine and saw that it was dirty. Tim knew that he needed to clean the engine so his train could go "Choo Choo!" again.

Tim took a cloth and wiped the engine clean. When he was done, he put the engine back on the train. The train started to move and went "Choo Choo!" Tim was very happy and played with his train all day long.

Ben likes to play golf with his dad. They go to a big field with holes and flags. Ben has a small stick and a white ball. His dad has a big stick and a white ball. They take turns to hit the ball and try to get it in the hole.

One day, Ben sees a dog on the field. The dog is brown and fluffy. He has a red collar and a tag. The dog runs to Ben and wags his tail. He is playful and friendly. Ben wants to pet the dog, but his dad says no. He says the dog might bite or take the ball.

Ben listens to his dad, but he still likes the dog. He smiles and waves at the dog. The dog barks and jumps. He is happy to see Ben. Then the dog does something funny. He picks up his front legs and puts them on the ground. He lowers his head and sticks his tail up. He bows to Ben, like he is saying hello.

Ben laughs and claps his hands. He thinks the dog is very smart and cute. He says, "Good dog, good dog!" His dad smiles too. He says, "That's a nice bow, dog. You are very polite." The dog wags his tail more. He likes Ben and his dad.

Ben and his dad finish their game of golf. They say goodbye to the dog. They hope to see him again. The dog watches them go. He hopes to see them again too. He likes to play golf with them. He thinks they are very nice.

Once upon a time, in a little house, there was a wise old owl. The owl lived near a big fireplace. Every day, he would gather wood to keep the fire burning.

One day, a little girl came to visit the owl. She said, "Mr. Owl, can you help me find my way home?" The owl looked at her and said, "Yes, little girl, I can help you. But first, let's gather some wood for the fireplace."

They went outside and picked up wood. The little girl was happy to help. They put the wood in the fireplace, and the fire grew big and warm.

As they sat by the fire, the wise owl told the little girl how to find her way home. "Follow the path by the big tree, and you will find your house," he said.

The little girl thanked the owl and went on her way. She followed the path and found her house. She was happy to be home and grateful for the wise owl's help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy who was 3 years old. She lived by a big wet building. One day, Lucy decided to explore the wet building. It looked kind of scary, but she was brave.

When Lucy got to the building, she saw a big scary door. Then, she heard a noise coming from inside. It made her jump!

"Hello? Is anybody there?" Lucy said.

Suddenly, the door opened and a big bad man appeared. He was very mean and he was making a lot of noise.

"What are you doing here?" The mean man said.

Lucy was scared and didn't know what to say, so she just ran away. The man chased after her and wouldn't let her go. He disturbed her until she cried and screamed.

The bad man was too strong for Lucy. He caught her and the bad story had a very bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the hot sun. But today, the weather was not so hot. It was cloudy and rainy. Lily was sad because she could not play outside.

Lily's mom had an idea to make her happy. They went to the store to buy decorations. They bought balloons, streamers, and a big banner that said "Happy Birthday". Lily was confused because it was not her birthday. But her mom said they were going to decorate the house to make it look like a party.

Lily helped her mom decorate the house. She put up the balloons and streamers. She was so happy that she forgot about the rainy weather. When they finished decorating, they had a party inside the house. They danced and sang and had so much fun. Lily was no longer sad because she had a fun party inside her house!

Once upon a time, there was a mighty dog named Max. Max loved to play ball on the pitch near his home. One sunny day, Max saw a little girl named Lucy. Lucy was sad because she lost her ball.

Max wanted to help Lucy. He said, "Don't worry, I will find your ball!" Max ran all around the pitch, looking for the ball. He looked under the trees and behind the bushes. Finally, he found the ball near a big rock.

Max brought the ball back to Lucy. She was so happy! She said, "Thank you, Max! You are a mighty helper!" They played ball together until the sun began to set. As the day came to an end, Max and Lucy walked home, knowing they had made a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to look at the stars at night. One night, he saw a bright comet in the sky. He was so excited that he wanted to catch it.

Timmy ran outside and tried to catch the comet, but it was too high up in the sky. Suddenly, he tripped and fell down. He hurt his knee and started to cry.

Timmy's mom came outside and saw that he was hurt. She helped him up and cleaned his knee. She told him that it's not good to try and catch things that are too far away. She said that sometimes, we need to ask for help when we can't do things on our own.

Timmy learned that it's okay to ask for help when he needs it. He also learned that sometimes, things that seem really cool can be bad for us if we try to do them on our own. From that day on, Timmy always asked for help when he needed it.

Lily and Ben were playing with a big ball in the park. They liked to bounce the ball high and catch it. Sometimes they bounced it to each other and said, "Catch!"

One day, they saw a bee flying near a flower. Lily wanted to see the bee closer, so she bounced the ball to Ben and ran to the flower. Ben followed her with the ball.

"Hello, bee," Lily said. "What are you doing?"

The bee buzzed and said, "I am making honey. Honey is sweet and good. I take nectar from the flowers and bring it to my hive."

"Can we have some honey?" Ben asked.

The bee shook his head and said, "No, honey is for bees. We work hard to make it. You have your own food. You should not take what is not yours."

Lily and Ben felt sorry. They did not want to make the bee angry. They said, "We are sorry, bee. We did not know. We will not take your honey. We will play with our ball."

The bee smiled and said, "Thank you, children. You are kind and respectful. You can watch me make honey, but do not touch. And be careful of the other bees. They might sting you if you bother them."

Lily and Ben nodded and said, "Okay, bee. We will be careful. We like to watch you make honey. It is amazing."

They went back to their ball and bounced it again. They learned that bees are important and make sweet honey. They also learned that they should not take what is not theirs. They should be happy with what they have.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, but one day he accidentally broke a toy car. He was very sad because it was his favorite toy.

Timmy's mom saw him crying and asked, "What happened, Timmy?"

"I broke my car," Timmy said, tears in his eyes.

"Don't worry, Timmy," his mom said. "We can replace it with a new one."

Timmy's face lit up with joy. "Really? A new green car?"

"Yes, a new green car," his mom said with a smile.

Timmy was so happy that he hugged his mom tightly. From that day on, he made sure to take good care of his toys so he wouldn't have to replace them again.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a nice eraser that she loved to use. She would always erase her mistakes with it. One day, Lily's eraser disappeared. She looked everywhere for it, but it was nowhere to be found. She was very sad.

Lily asked her friends if they had seen her eraser, but they hadn't. She even asked her teacher, but she didn't know where it was either. Lily felt like she would never find her eraser again.

Days turned into weeks, and Lily still couldn't find her eraser. She started to feel angry and frustrated. Then one day, Lily saw her eraser in another girl's pencil case. Lily was so upset that she grabbed the eraser and ran away.

Lily's friends tried to stop her, but she didn't listen. She ran out of the classroom and into the street. Suddenly, a car appeared out of nowhere and hit Lily. She was hurt badly and had to go to the hospital. Lily learned that it's not nice to take things that don't belong to you, and that sometimes things disappear for a reason.

Anna and Ben were twins who liked to play with their toys. Anna had a doll that she loved very much. Ben had a car that he liked to zoom around. Sometimes, they would share their toys, but sometimes they would fight over them.

One day, Anna wanted to play with Ben's car, but Ben said no. He said it was his car and he did not want to give it to her. Anna was envious of Ben's car. She thought it was more fun than her doll. She tried to grab the car from Ben, but he held it tight. They started to tug and pull on the car.

Suddenly, they felt the floor shake. They heard a loud noise. They saw things fall from the shelves. It was an earthquake! They were scared and let go of the car. They ran to their mom, who was in the kitchen. She hugged them and told them to stay calm. She said they had to go outside, where it was safer.

They followed their mom to the door, but Anna remembered her doll. She had left it on the couch. She did not want to lose her doll. She ran back to get it. Ben saw her and followed her. He did not want to leave her alone.

They reached the couch and saw the car and the doll on the floor. The car was broken. One of its wheels had come off. The doll was fine. Anna picked up the doll and hugged it. She felt sorry for Ben. She said, "I'm sorry, Ben. Your car is broken. Do you want to play with my doll?"

Ben looked at the car and felt sad. He said, "It's okay, Anna. It was just a toy. I'm glad you and your doll are okay. Thank you for sharing with me."

They hugged each other and returned to their mom. She was happy to see them. She said, "I'm proud of you, Anna and Ben. You were brave and kind. You learned to share and care. Now let's go outside and wait for the earthquake to stop."

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl. She was playing in the living room with her best friend, a teddy bear. The little girl's mommy was walking around the house, looking at bookshelves and stretching her arms.

"Mommy, why are you stretching?" asked the little girl.

"I'm stretching my arms, honey," answered her mommy.

"But why?" asked the little girl.

"Oh, because the bookshelves are high," replied her mommy. "I need to reach the top shelf so I can put some books back in their place."

"OK, mommy!" said the little girl. Then she got up and stood next to her mommy and started to stretch her arms too. They both reached for the top shelf and put the books back in their place.

It was a lot of fun for the little girl and her mommy, and at the end of the day, the bookshelf was all neat and tidy.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she saw a group of butterflies flying in the park. The butterflies were so attractive with their colorful wings. Lily wanted to follow them and see where they were going.

She asked her mom, "Mommy, can I follow the butterflies?"

Her mom replied, "Sure, Lily. But be careful and don't go too far."

Lily followed the butterflies as they flew from flower to flower. She was so happy to see them up close. Suddenly, the butterflies flew away and Lily couldn't find them anymore. She went back to her mom and said, "Mommy, the butterflies are gone. But it was so fun to follow them!"

John pulled the red automobile close to him. He liked the way it moved backward and forward. Suddenly, the automobile stopped moving. Its wheels were still spinning but it wouldn't go anywhere.

John saw that the engine was dead. He had to find a way to get it working again so he could have fun with it. He looked around for help, but no one was near.

He spotted a big yellow truck in a nearby driveway. He walked to the truck and pulled the handle on the door. It opened, so he climbed inside and pulled the truck's key. He put the key in the automobile's engine and turned it.

The engine came back to life! John's automobile started moving again. He was so happy that he drove it around and around, enjoying the feel of the wind against his face. He had saved the day!

Once upon a time, there were two friends called Minnie and Matt. They were out playing in the park when Minnie saw something strange. She pointed at it and said "look Matt, what's that?".

Matt replied "it looks like an emergency, I'm not sure what it is".

Minnie asked "what do we do?".

Matt thought for a moment and then he said "let's go closer and have a look, I think it might be a yellow emergency".
